fields.title: Ku Bigere bya Mukama
fields.subtitle: Kyavvuunulwa okuva mu Luurudu, Omuweesimwa Arthur Parker ne Mukyala Parker
fields.description: Emboozi wakati w’Omuyigirizwa ne Mukama, Sadhu Sundar Singh mw’awandiikira amazima g’agamba nti Mukama yagamubikkulira mu kusaba: ku kulabisibwa kw’okubeerawo kwa Katonda, ku kibi n’obulokozi, ku kusaba, ku kuweereza, ku musaalaba n’ekyama ky’okubonaabona, ne ku ggulu ne ggeyeena. “Tekyandisobose gye ndi okunnyonnyola amazima gano ge nabikkulirwa,” bw’awandiika, “okuggyako mu lulimi lw’engero” — era bw’atyo Mukama addamu mu ngero: ey’ekyangwe ekiri mu mazzi, ey’ekisiriiza ekiri mu muliro, n’ey’omwana ayagala nnyina yekka. Kyavvuunulwa okuva mu Luurudu nga Sadhu yennyini ayambako.

qa.question: Ekitabo Ku Bigere bya Mukama kye ki?
qa.answer: Kitabo kitono eky’okwekulaakulanya mu by’omwoyo ekyawandiikibwa Sadhu Sundar Singh, Omukristaayo Omuyindi eyatambulanga ng’omusajja omutukuvu atalina w’abeera ng’abuulira Kristo. Kyawandiikibwa ng’emboozi wakati w’Omuyigirizwa ne Mukama, era kiwandiika amazima ge yakkiriza nti Kristo yamulaga mu kusaba. Kyasooka kufulumizibwa mu Luurudu, oluvannyuma ne kivvuunulwa mu Lungereza nga Sadhu yennyini ayambako.

qa.question: Lwaki kyawandiikibwa mu ngero?
qa.answer: Sundar Singh yagamba nti tekyandisobose gy’ali okunnyonnyola amazima ge yabikkulirwa okuggyako mu lulimi lw’engero. Ng’agoberera ekyokulabirako kya Yesu n’engeri y’okuyigiriza ey’e Buyindi, Mukama addamu ebibuuzo by’Omuyigirizwa n’ebifaananyi ebimpi okuva mu bulamu obwa bulijjo, ebireetera amazima ag’omwoyo okujjukirwa amangu n’obutayerabirwa.

qa.question: Olugero lw’ekyangwe lugamba ki?
qa.answer: Mukama agamba nti ng’ekyangwe bwe kibeera mu mazzi, amazzi ne gakijjuza, naye amazzi si kyangwe n’ekyangwe si mazzi, bw’atyo naye ali mu buli kifo ne mu buli kintu, naye ebintu ebyo si ye. Okwegatta ne Katonda kujjuza omukkiriza mu bujjuvu, naye Katonda n’omukkiriza basigala nga baawukana.

qa.question: Olugero lw’ekisiriiza lugamba ki?
qa.answer: Ekisiriiza kisigala kiddugavu ne bw’okyoza emirundi emeka. Naye omuliro bwe guyingira mu kyo, obuddugavu bwakyo buggwaawo ne kyaka. Bw’atyo, Mukama bw’agamba, bw’ayingira mu muntu mu kubatizibwa n’omuliro, obuddugavu bwonna obw’ekibi bugobebwa, era omuntu oyo n’afuuka omusana eri ensi. Ekibi kiwangulwa olw’okubeerawo kwe, so si lwa maanyi g’omuntu.

qa.question: Ekitabo kiyigiriza ki ku kusaba?
qa.answer: Mukama agamba nti okusaba kwe kussa omukka gw’Omwoyo wa Katonda awa obulamu. Ng’ebyennyanja bwe bimala obulamu bwabyo bwonna mu mazzi ag’omunnyo ag’ennyanja nga tebifuuka bya munnyo, kubanga birimu obulamu, bw’atyo omuntu asaba asigala nga mulongoofu newaakubadde abeera mu nsi eyonooneddwa ekibi. Okusaba si kwe kusaba bintu kyokka, wabula kwe kufuna Katonda yennyini.

qa.question: Olugero lw’omwana ne nnyina lugamba ki?
qa.answer: Lumu maama yeekweka mu nnimiro wakati mu bisaka ebikutte, mutabani we omuto n’agenda ng’amunoonya. Omuweereza bwe yamuwa emiyembe n’ebimuli ebirungi, omwana n’akaaba ng’agamba nti ayagala maama we, emmere ye n’okwagala kwe nga biwooma okusinga ebyo byonna. Mukama akozesa olugero luno okulaga nti abaana be ab’amazima baagala ye yennyini, so si birabo bye byokka.

fields.title: Ebigambo by’Abavvuunuzi
fields.body_html:
Akatabo kano kaasooka kufulumizibwa mu Luurudu e Buyindi, era eyo n’okuvvuunulwa mu Lungereza kwe kwafulumira.

Mu kuteekateeka okuvvuunula kuno twaweebwa omukisa Sadhu yennyini okukolera awamu naffe, era nga tuli wamu naye waliwo ebyakyusibwamu ebimu, ekigendererwa nga kwe kuggyawo ebitategeerekeka n’okwongera amakulu n’obutangaavu buli we kyasoboka. Nga tufuba okuvvuunula n’obwegendereza, twakozesa eddembe erimu mu ngeri y’okwogera buli we kyali kyetaagisa, naye nga tugenderera okukuuma omwoyo n’amakulu amatuufu ag’ekitabo ekyasooka.

Abo abaafuna omukisa, nga ffe, okulaba Sadhu ng’akola omulimu gwe e Buyindi, embeera yonna ey’ekitabo kino bagimanyi bulungi. Mu mpisa entuufu ez’Ebuvanjuba omuntu yamulabanga ng’atudde wansi ku ttaka wakati mu kibiina ekinene eky’abanoonya amazima abanyiikivu, abasajja n’abakazi ab’emitendera gyonna. Empisa ye mu biseera ng’ebyo tewerabirwa. Obwangu bwe n’amagezi ge ag’obulijjo emirundi mingi byabikkulanga omutima gwennyini ogw’ekizibu eky’omwoyo, era obusaagi bwe obukkakkamu bwaleetangamu oluusi akaseko, nga kaddamu ne kakkakkana ne kafuuka okussaamu ekitiibwa amakulu amazito ag’okuddamu kwe bwe gaatandikanga okuwulirwa.

Omusajja yennyini, mu mbeera ye ey’ekisa n’ekitiibwa, aleka akabonero akatasangulukuka ku birowoozo. Afuuka okusinga okuba ekijjukizo ekisanyusa; asigala ng’amaanyi agasika mu bulamu bw’abangi abaatuula naye ku bigere bya Mukama.

Akatabo kano kafuluma ng’ekiva mu birowoozo ebyagololwa ne birongoosebwa olw’ebyo bye yayitamu n’okufumiitiriza nga bw’asaba, ebyalondebwa Mukama ow’okwagala n’okusaasira okumumanyisa mu bulamu awamu ne mu kigambo.

Arthur Parker

Rebecca J. Parker

fields.title: Ekigambo Ekisooka
fields.body_html:
Ebigambo bya Kristo—

“Mmwe mumpita Muyigiriza era Mukama wammwe, mukola bulungi okumpita bwe mutyo kubanga ddala bwe ntyo bwe ndi.” (Yokaana 13:13)

“Musitule ekikoligo kyange, muyigire ku nze, . . . n’emyoyo gyammwe girifuna ekiwummulo.” (Matayo 11:29)

Tewali kintu kyonna mu nsi ekituukiridde ennyo nga tekiyinza kuvumirirwa wadde okunenyezebwa. Enjuba yennyini etuwa omusana n’ebbugumu terina kye yeewala ku mabala, naye newaakubadde ng’erina obunafu obwo, tereka mulimu gwayo ogwa bulijjo. Kitugwanira naffe mu ngeri y’emu okutuukiriza nga bwe tusobola ekyo kye twateresebwa, n’okufuba bulijjo okufuula obulamu bwaffe obubala ebibala.

Amazima agannyonnyolwa mu kitabo kino bwe gaambikkulirwa Mukama, gaakwata nnyo ku bulamu bwange, era agamu ku go nagakozesa mu kubuulira kwange n’emboozi zange e Bulaaya, Amerika, Afirika, Australia ne Asia. Mikwano gyange bangi bwe bansaba, kaakano ngakuŋŋaanyizza wamu mu katabo kano akatono, era newaakubadde nga kiyinzika okubaawo obunafu mu ngeri gye ngannyonnyolamu, nkakasa nti abo abanaagasoma nga basaba era n’omutima ogutaliimu kyekubiira bajja kuganyulwa nga nze bwe nnaganyulwa.

Tekyandisobose gye ndi okunnyonnyola amazima gano ge nabikkulirwa okuggyako mu lulimi lw’engero, naye olw’okukozesa engero omulimu gwange gubadde mwangu nnyo.

Kye nsaba kiri nti nga Katonda olw’ekisa kye n’okusaasira kwe bw’ampadde omukisa olw’amazima gano, bwe gatyo n’eri buli musomi gabe mukisa.

Omuddu wo omwetoowaze,

Sundar Singh

fields.title: Ennyanjula
fields.body_html:
Okwolesebwa Okusooka

Lumu ekiro ekyali ekizikiza nnagenda nzekka mu kibira okusaba, ne ntuula ku lwazi ne ntegeeza Katonda ebyetaago byange ebinene, ne mmwegayirira anyambe. Oluvannyuma lw’akaseera katono, bwe nnalaba omusajja omwavu ng’ajja gye ndi, ne ndowooza nti azze kunsaba kimuyamba kubanga alumwa enjala n’obunnyogovu. Ne mmugamba nti, “Nange ndi mwavu, era okuggyako bulangiti eno, sirina kintu kyonna. Waakiri ogende mu kyalo ekiri okumpi osabe obuyambi eyo.” Era laba! nga nkyayogera ebyo, n’amyansa ng’eraddu, era ng’amansira amatondo g’omukisa, amangu ago n’abula. Woowe! Woowe! Kaakano kyali kintegeerekedde nti ono yali Mukama wange omwagalwa, ataajja kusabiriza okuva ku kitonde ekyavu nga nze, wabula okumpa omukisa n’okungaggawaza (2 Abakkolinso 8:9), era bwe ntyo ne nsigala nga nkaaba era nga nkungubagira obusirusiru bwange n’obutategeera bwange.

Okwolesebwa Okw’okubiri

Lunaku lulala, omulimu gwange bwe gwaggwa, ne nzirayo nate mu kibira okusaba, ne ntuula ku lwazi lwe lumu, ne ntandika okulowooza mikisa ki gye nnandisabye. Bwe nnali nkyali mu ekyo, ne kiringa nti omuntu omulala azze n’ayimirira okumpi nange, ng’okusinziira ku nneeyisa ye, ku byambalo bye ne ku ngeri gy’ayogeramu, yalabika ng’omuweereza wa Katonda assibwamu ekitiibwa era eyeewaddeyo; naye amaaso ge gaamasamasa olukujjukujju n’obukuusa, era bwe yali ayogera nga gy’obeera nti assa omukka ogw’ekivundu kya ggeyeena.

N’ayogera nange bw’ati: “Ssebo Omutukuvu era Assibwamu Ekitiibwa, nsonyiwa okukusalako mu kusaba kwo n’okuyingirira ekifo kyo eky’ekyama; naye buvunaanyizibwa bwa muntu okufuba okuyamba abalala okukulaakulana, era kyenvudde nzija okukutegeeza ensonga enkulu. Obulamu bwo obulongoofu obutaliimu kwefaako bukutte nnyo si ku nze kyokka, wabula ne ku bantu bangi nnyo abatya Katonda. Naye newaakubadde ng’olw’erinnya lya Katonda weewaddeyo omubiri n’emmeeme ku lw’abalala, tonnaba kusiimibwa nga bw’osaanidde. Kye ntegeeza kiri nti olw’okuba oli Mukristaayo, Abakristaayo enkumi ntono bokka be bakwatiddwako, era n’abamu ku bo tebakwesiga. Tekyandibadde kirungi nnyo singa wafuuka Omuhindu oba Omusiraamu, n’ofuuka ddala omukulembeze omukulu? Bo banoonya omukulu ow’omwoyo bw’atyo. Bw’onokkiriza ekiteeso kyange kino, olwo Abahindu n’Abasiraamu obukadde ebikumi bisatu mu kkumi bajja kufuuka abagoberezi bo, bakuweeke ekitiibwa n’okukussaamu ekitiibwa.”

Amangu ddala nga mpulidde ebyo, ebigambo bino ne bifubutuka mu kamwa kange: “Ggwe Setaani! Vaawo! Namanyiddewo nti oli musege ogwambadde olususu lw’endiga! Ky’oyagala kyokka kiri nti ndeke omusaalaba n’ekkubo eddungi erigenda mu bulamu, ndonde oluguudo olugazi olw’okufa. Mukama wange yennyini gwe mugabo gwange era gwe busika bwange, oyo yennyini eyawaayo obulamu bwe ku lwange, era kiŋŋwanidde okuwaayo nga ssaddaaka obulamu bwange ne byonna bye nnina eri oyo, gyendi ali byonna mu byonna. Kale genda, kubanga nze naawe tetulina kye tukolagana.”

Bwe yawulira ebyo n’agenda ng’ayemulugunya era ng’awuluguma olw’obusungu bwe. Nange, nga nkaaba, ne nfuka emmeeme yange eri Katonda mu kusaba bwe nti: “Mukama wange Katonda, byonna byange mu byonna, obulamu bw’obulamu bwange, era omwoyo gw’omwoyo gwange, ntunuulira n’okusaasira, onjijuze Omwoyo wo Omutukuvu, omutima gwange guleme kuba na kifo kya kwagala kintu kyonna okuggyako ggwe. Sikusaba kirabo kirala kyonna okuggyako ggwe wennyini, ggwe Agaba obulamu n’emikisa gyabwo gyonna. Sikusaba nsi wadde obugagga bwayo, wadde eggulu sirisaba, wabula ggwe wekka gwe njagala era gwe neegomba, era ggwe gy’oli eyo ye Ggulu. Enjala n’ennyonta ey’omutima gwange guno bisobola okumalibwawo ggwe wekka eyaguzaala. Ayi Omutonzi wange! Omutima gwange waagutonda ku lwo wekka, so si ku lw’omulala, n’olwekyo omutima gwange guno teguyinza kufuna kiwummulo wadde emirembe okuggyako mu ggwe, mu ggwe eyagutonda era eyagussaamu okwegomba kuno kwennyini okw’okuwummula. Kale ggyamu mu mutima gwange byonna ebikuwakanya, oyingire, obeere omwo, era ofuge emirembe gyonna. Amiina.”

Bwe nnasituka okuva mu kusaba okwo ne ndaba Omuntu ayakaayakana, ayambadde omusana n’obulungi, ng’ayimiridde mu maaso gange. Newaakubadde nga teyayogera kigambo na kimu, era olw’amaaso gange okuba nga gajjudde amaziga saamulaba bulungi nnyo, ebimyanso ebiringa eraddu eby’okwagala okuwa obulamu byava gy’ali n’amaanyi mangi bwe gatyo ne biyingira ne binaaza emmeeme yange ddala. Amangu ago ne mmanya nti Omulokozi wange omwagalwa yali ayimiridde mu maaso gange. Ne nsituka mangu okuva ku lwazi lwe nnali ntuddeko ne ngwa ku bigere bye. Yali akutte mu mukono gwe ekisumuluzo ky’omutima gwange. Bwe yaggula ekisenge eky’omunda eky’omutima gwange n’ekisumuluzo kye eky’okwagala, n’akijjuza okubeerawo kwe, era buli we nnatunuulira, munda oba ebweru, nnalabanga ye yekka.

Awo ne mmanya nti omutima gw’omuntu ye ntebe y’obwakabaka n’ekigo kya Katonda kyennyini, era nti bw’ayingira omwo okubeeramu, eggulu litandika. Mu katikitiki ako akatono yajjuza nnyo omutima gwange, era n’ayogera ebigambo eby’ekitalo ennyo, ne bwe nnandiwandiise ebitabo bingi sandisobodde kubyogera byonna. Kubanga ebintu bino eby’omu ggulu bisobola okunnyonnyolwa mu lulimi lw’omu ggulu lwokka, n’ennimi ez’omu nsi tezimala kubyogera. Naye nja kufuba okuwandiika ebitono ku bintu bino eby’omu ggulu ebyanzijira okuva eri Mukama mu kwolesebwa. Ku lwazi kwe nnali ntudde edda, ye n’atuulako, nange nga ndi ku bigere bye, ne watandika wakati wa Mukama n’omuyigirizwa emboozi eddirira.

fields.title: Okulabisibwa kw’Okubeerawo kwa Katonda
fields.body_html:
Ekitundu I

Omuyigirizwa,—Ayi Mukama, Ensulo y’obulamu! Lwaki weekweka abo abakusinza, so tosanyusa maaso g’abo abeegomba okukutunuulira?

Mukama,—1. Mwana wange ow’amazima, essanyu ery’amazima teryesigama ku kulaba kw’amaaso, wabula lijjira mu kulaba okw’omwoyo, era lyesigama ku mutima. Mu Palestina enkumi n’enkumi zantunuulira, naye bonna tebaafuna bwe batyo ssanyu lya mazima. Amaaso agafa gasobola kulaba ebyo byokka ebifa, kubanga amaaso ag’omubiri tegasobola kulaba Katonda atafa n’ebitonde eby’omwoyo. Ng’ekyokulabirako, ggwe wennyini tosobola kulaba mwoyo gwo, kale oyinza otya okulaba Omutonzi waagwo? Naye amaaso ag’omwoyo bwe gazibuka, olwo ddala osobola okulaba oyo ali Omwoyo (Yokaana 4:24), era ekyo ky’olaba kaakano ku nze tokiraba na maaso ga mubiri, wabula n’amaaso ag’omwoyo.

Bw’oba, nga bw’ogamba, enkumi n’enkumi z’abantu zannaba e Palestina, olwo amaaso gaabwe gonna ag’omwoyo gaali gazibuse, oba nze nnafuuka omuntu afa? Okuddamu kuli nti, Nedda! Nnatwala omubiri ogufa, nsobole okuguwaayo ng’omutango olw’ebibi by’ensi; era omulimu gw’obulokozi bwe gwaggwa ku lw’aboonoonyi (Yokaana 19:30), ekyo ekitafa ne kikyusa ekyo ekifa ne kifuuka ekitiibwa. N’olwekyo oluvannyuma lw’okuzuukira abo bokka abaali baweereddwa okulaba okw’omwoyo be baasobola okundaba (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 10:40-41).

2. Waliwo bangi mu nsi muno abammanyiiko, naye nga tebammanyi; kwe kugamba tebalina nkolagana yaabwe ku bwabwe nange, n’olwekyo tebalina kutegeera kwa mazima wadde okukkiriza mu nze, so tebankkiriza ng’Omulokozi waabwe era Mukama waabwe.

Ng’omuntu bw’ayogera n’omusajja eyazaalibwa nga muzibe w’amaaso ku langi ez’enjawulo, gamba emmyufu, bbulu, eya kyenvu, asigala nga tamanyi n’akatono bulungi bwazo n’obubalagavu bwazo, tasobola kuzitwala nga za muwendo, kubanga azimanyiiko bumanyi, era amanyi amannya gazo ag’enjawulo. Naye ku langi tasobola kuba na kutegeera kwa mazima okutuusa amaaso ge lwe ganaazibuka. Mu ngeri y’emu okutuusa amaaso g’omuntu ag’omwoyo lwe ganaazibuka, ne bw’aba muyivu atya, tasobola kummanya, tasobola kulaba kitiibwa kyange, era tasobola kutegeera nti nze Katonda eyafuuka omuntu.

3. Waliwo abakkiriza bangi abategeera okubeerawo kwange mu mitima gyabwe nga kubaleetera obulamu obw’omwoyo n’emirembe, naye nga tebasobola kundaba bulungi. Ng’eriiso bwe lisobola okulaba ebintu bingi, naye omuntu bw’alitonnyezaamu eddagala eriiso teririraba, wabula okubeerawo kw’eddagala kuwulirwa nga kulongoosa eriiso munda era nga kwongera amaanyi g’okulaba.

4. Emirembe egy’amazima egizaalibwa okubeerawo kwange mu mitima gy’abakkiriza ab’amazima tebasobola kugiraba, naye nga bawulira amaanyi gaagyo, basanyukira mu gyo. So tebasobola kulaba ssanyu eryo ery’ebirowoozo oba ery’omutima mwe banyumirwa emirembe gy’okubeerawo kwange. Bwe kiri n’olulimi n’ebiwoomerera. Obusobozi bw’okuloza obuli mu lulimi n’obuwoomi bwe luwulira byombi tebirabika. Bwe ntyo nange mpa abaana bange obulamu n’essanyu nga nkozesa maanu eyakwekebwa, ensi n’amagezi gaayo gonna gy’etamanyi era gy’etayinza kumanya (Okubikkulirwa 2:7).

5. Oluusi mu bulwadde obusobozi bw’okuloza mu lulimi butaataaganyizibwa, era mu kiseera ekyo, emmere omulwadde gy’aweebwa ne bw’eba nnungi etya, gy’ali ewooma bubi. Mu ngeri y’emu ddala ekibi kitaataaganya okuwoomerwa ebintu eby’omwoyo. Mu mbeera ng’eyo Ekigambo kyange, n’okuweereza, n’okubeerawo kwange bifiirwa okusikiriza kwabyo eri omwonoonyi, era mu kifo ky’okubiganyulwamu, atandika okubiwakanya n’okubinenya.

6. Ate abakkiriza bangi—ng’omusajja eyazaalibwa nga muzibe w’amaaso, bwe yazibuka—basobola okulaba Yesu nga nnabbi era Omwana w’Omuntu, naye tebamutwala nga Kristo era Omwana wa Katonda (Yokaana 9:17, 35-37), okutuusa lwe mbalabikira omulundi ogw’okubiri mu maanyi.

7. Lumu maama yeekweka mu nnimiro wakati mu bisaka ebikutte ennyo, mutabani we omuto n’agenda ng’amunoonya wano ne wali, ng’akaaba bw’agenda. Yatambula ennimiro yonna, naye n’atamulaba. Omuweereza n’amugamba nti, “Kaana, tokaaba! Laba emiyembe gino ku muti guno n’ebimuli byonna ebirungi ennyo eby’omu nnimiro. Jjangu, ŋŋenda kukunogerako.” Naye omwana n’akaaba nti, “Nedda! Nedda! Njagala maama wange. Emmere gy’ampa ewooma okusinga emiyembe gyonna, n’okwagala kwe kuwooma nnyo okusinga ebimuli bino byonna, era ddala omanyi nti ennimiro eno yonna yange, kubanga byonna maama wange by’alina byange. Nedda! Njagala maama wange!” Maama bwe yawulira ebyo ng’ali mu bisaka gye yeekwese, n’afubutuka, n’asitula omwana we n’amunyweza ku kifuba kye, n’amunywegera emirundi egitabalika, era ennimiro eyo n’efuuka olusuku lwa Katonda eri omwana. Bwe batyo n’abaana bange tebasobola kufuna mu nnimiro eno ennene ey’ensi, ejjudde ebintu ebisanyusa era ebirungi, ssanyu lya mazima lyonna okutuusa lwe bandaba. Nze Imanueli waabwe, abeera nabo bulijjo, era mbeemanyisa (Yokaana 14:21).

8. Ng’ekyangwe bwe kibeera mu mazzi, amazzi ne gakijjuza, naye amazzi si kyangwe n’ekyangwe si mazzi, wabula bulijjo bisigala nga bintu bibiri ebyawukana, bwe batyo n’abaana babeera mu nze nange mu bo. Kino si kugamba nti buli kintu Katonda, wabula bwe bwakabaka bwa Katonda, obuteekebwawo mu mitima gy’abo ababeera mu nsi muno; era ng’amazzi agali mu kyangwe, ndi mu buli kifo ne mu buli kintu, naye ebintu ebyo si nze (Lukka 17:21).

9. Twala ekisiriiza, era ne bw’onookyoza emirundi emeka obuddugavu bwakyo tebuggweewo, naye leka omuliro guyingire mu kyo, langi yaakyo enzirugavu n’evaawo. Bwe kityo omwonoonyi bw’afuna Omwoyo Omutukuvu (ava eri Kitange n’eri nze, kubanga nze ne Kitange tuli omu), kwe kubatizibwa n’omuliro, obuddugavu bwonna obw’ekibi bugobebwa, era n’afuulibwa omusana eri ensi (Matayo 3:11, 14). Ng’omuliro mu kisiriiza, bwe ntyo nze mbeera mu baana bange nabo mu nze, era mu bo mwe nneeyolesa eri ensi.

Ekitundu II

Omuyigirizwa,—Mukama, singa weeyoleka mu ngeri ey’enjawulo eri ensi, abantu tebandiddamu kubuusabuusa kubeerawo kwa Katonda n’obwakatonda bwo, wabula bonna bandikkirizza ne batandika okutambulira mu kkubo ery’obutuukirivu.

Mukama,—1. Mwana wange, embeera ey’omunda ey’omuntu yenna ngimanyi bulungi, era buli mutima nneemanyisa gye guli ng’ebyetaago byagwo bwe biri; era okuleeta omuntu mu kkubo ery’obutuukirivu tewali ngeri esinga kwolesa nze kennyini. Ku lw’omuntu nnafuuka omuntu alyoke amanye Katonda, si ng’omuntu ow’entiisa era omugwira, wabula ng’ajjudde okwagala era afaanana naye, kubanga omuntu afaanana Katonda era yatondebwa mu kifaananyi kye.

Omuntu era alina okwegomba kuno okw’obutonde, okulaba oyo gw’akkiriza era amwagala. Naye Kitange tasobola kulabibwa, kubanga mu butonde bwe tategeerekeka, era oyo ayagala okumutegeera alina okuba n’obutonde bwe bumu. Naye omuntu kitonde kya kigero, era olw’okuba bw’ali, tasobola kulaba Katonda. Naye kubanga Katonda kwagala, era omuntu yamuwa obusobozi obwo bwennyini obw’okwagala, n’olwekyo, okwegomba okwo okw’okwagala kulyoke kumalibwe, yeetwalira engeri y’okubeerawo omuntu gy’asobola okutegeera. Bw’atyo n’afuuka omuntu, era abaana be awamu ne bamalayika abatukuvu bonna basobole okumulaba n’okumusanyukira (Abakkolosaayi 1:15; 2:9). Kyennava njogera nti, ‘Buli alaba Nze aba alabye Kitange!’ (Yokaana 14:9-10). Era newaakubadde nga bwe ndi mu kifaananyi ky’omuntu nnyitibwa Omwana, nze Kitaffe ow’emirembe n’emirembe atalina nkomerero (Isaaya 9:6).

2. Nze ne Kitange n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu tuli Omu. Ng’enjuba bw’erimu ebbugumu n’omusana, naye omusana si bbugumu, n’ebbugumu si musana, naye byombi kimu, newaakubadde nga mu kweyoleka kwabyo birina engeri za njawulo, bwe tutyo nze n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, nga tuva eri Kitange, tuleeta omusana n’ebbugumu mu nsi. Omwoyo, gwe muliro ogw’okubatiza, ayokya n’afuula evvu mu mitima gy’abakkiriza buli ngeri ya kibi n’obutali butuukirivu, n’abafuula abalongoofu era abatukuvu. Nze ali Omusana ow’Amazima (Yokaana 1:9; 8:12), mmalawo okwegomba kwonna okw’ekizikiza n’okubi, era nga mbakulembera mu kkubo ery’obutuukirivu, ku nkomerero mbatuusa mu maka gaabwe ag’olubeerera. Naye ffe tetuli basatu wabula Omu, ng’enjuba bw’eri emu yokka.

3. Omuwendo gwonna n’amaanyi n’obusobozi obw’awaggulu Katonda bwe yawa omuntu birina okukozesebwa, bwe bitaba bwe bityo bigenda biggwaawo mpolampola ne bifa. Bwe kityo okukkiriza, bwe kutanywezebwa ddala ku Katonda omulamu, kumenyebwamenyebwa okukubwa kw’ekibi ne kufuuka okubuusabuusa. Emirundi mingi omuntu awulira ekintu nga kino: “Singa okubuusabuusa kwange kuno oba kuli kuggibwawo nnandibadde mwetegefu okukkiriza.” Ekyo kiri ng’omuntu omenyese ekitundu ky’omubiri asaba omusawo amuggyeko obulumi nga tannaba kuyunga kitundu ekyo. Mazima obwo busirusiru, kubanga obulumi buva ku kumenyeka kw’ekitundu, era bwe kinaayungibwa obulumi bujja kuggwaawo bwokka. Bwe kityo olw’ekikolwa ky’ekibi enkolagana y’omuntu ne Katonda yakutuka, era okubuusabuusa, bwe bulumi obw’omwoyo, ne kuzaalibwa. N’olwekyo kyetaagisa ddala okwegatta ne Katonda okuzzibwa obuggya, olwo okubuusabuusa okwo okuzze ku bwakatonda bwange ne ku kubeerawo kwa Katonda kujja kuggwaawo kwokka. Olwo mu kifo ky’obulumi mujja kujja emirembe egyo egy’ekitalo ensi gy’etayinza kuwa wadde okuggyawo. Kyennava nfuuka omubiri, wabeewo okwegatta wakati wa Katonda n’abantu abaavu abamenyese, basobole okusanyukira wamu naye mu ggulu emirembe n’emirembe.

4. Katonda kwagala, era mu buli kiramu yateekamu obusobozi buno obw’okwagala, naye okusingira ddala mu muntu. N’olwekyo kye kituufu ddala nti Omwagazi eyatuwa obulamu n’okutegeera n’okwagala kwennyini afune omusolo gw’okwagala ogumugwanira. Okwegomba kwe kuli eri byonna bye yatonda, era okwagala kuno bwe kutakozesebwa bulungi, era bwe tutaagala n’omutima gwaffe gwonna n’emmeeme yaffe yonna n’amagezi gaffe gonna n’amaanyi gaffe gonna oyo eyatuwa okwagala, olwo okwagala okwo kugwa okuva mu kifo kyakwo eky’awaggulu ne kufuuka okwefaako. Bwe kityo wazaalibwawo akabi eri ffe ffennyini n’eri ebitonde bya Katonda ebirala. Buli muntu eyeefaako yekka, ekyewuunyisa, afuuka eyeetta yekka.

Era kino nkyogedde nti, “Yagalanga muliraanwa wo nga gwe bwe weeyagala wekka.” Kaakano newaakubadde nga mu ngeri emu abantu bonna baliraanwa ba bannaabwe, naye kino kyogera okusingira ddala ku abo ababeera okumpi n’abalala bulijjo, kubanga kyangu okubeera mu mirembe n’omuntu ali okumpi okumala ennaku ntono zokka, ne bw’aba nga si mukwano; naye ku muntu abeera okumpi naawe, era buli lunaku akuleetera obuzibu, kizibu nnyo okumugumiikiriza n’okumwagala nga ggwe bwe weeyagala. Naye bw’onoowangula mu lutalo luno olunene kijja kukwanguyira okwagala abalala bonna nga ggwe bwe weeyagala.

Omuntu bw’ayagala Katonda n’omutima gwe gwonna, n’amagezi ge, n’emmeeme ye, ne muliraanwa we nga bwe yeeyagala, tewajja kubaawo kifo kya kubuusabuusa, wabula mu ye mujja kunywezebwa Obwakabaka obwo obwa Katonda obutaliiko nkomerero, era ye, ng’asaanuusiddwa era ng’abumbiddwa mu muliro gw’okwagala, ajja kufuulibwa ekifaananyi kya Kitaawe ow’omu ggulu, eyamutonda olubereberye ng’amufaananya ye.

5. Era nneeyolesa nga nkozesa Ekigambo kyange (Bayibuli) eri abo abannoonya n’omutima ogw’amazima. Nga bwe nnatwala omubiri gw’omuntu olw’obulokozi bw’abantu, bwe kityo n’Ekigambo kyange, nga gwe mwoyo era bwe bulamu (Yokaana 6:63), kyawandiikibwa mu lulimi lw’abantu, kwe kugamba, mu kyo mwegattiramu ebyaluŋŋamizibwa Katonda n’eby’obuntu. Naye ng’abantu bwe batantegeera, bwe batyo tebategeera Kigambo kyange. Okukitegeera tekyetaagisa kumanya Lwebbulaniya na Luyonaani, wabula ekyetaagisa kwe kussa ekimu n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu oyo, bannabbi n’abatume mwe baabeeranga nga bakiwandiika. Awatali kubuusabuusa olulimi lw’Ekigambo kino lwa mwoyo, era oyo yekka azaaliddwa Omwoyo y’asobola okukitegeera mu bujjuvu, ka abe ng’amanyi okunenya kw’abayivu b’ensi oba nga mwana muto bumuto, kubanga olulimi olwo olw’omwoyo alutegeera bulungi kubanga lwe lulimi lwe olw’obuzaaliranwa. Naye jjukira nti abo amagezi gaabwe ag’ensi eno yokka tebasobola kukitegeera, kubanga tebalina mugabo mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu.

6. Mu kitabo ky’obutonde, nange kye nnawandiika, nneeyolesa mu bujjuvu. Naye n’okusoma ekitabo kino kwetaagisa okulaba okw’omwoyo, abantu balyoke bansange, bwe kitaba bwe kityo waliwo akabi nti mu kifo ky’okunsanga babula.

Bw’atyo omuzibe w’amaaso akozesa obusongezo bw’engalo ze ng’amaaso, era ng’akwatako bukwasi asoma ekitabo, naye ng’akwatako bukwasi tasobola kutegeera ddala mazima gaakyo. Okunoonyereza kw’abo abagamba nti Katonda tamanyika n’ab’okubuusabuusa kukakasa kino, kubanga mu kifo ky’obutuukirivu balaba bulemu bwokka. Abanenya abanoonya ensobi babuuza nti, “Oba nga waliwo Omutonzi w’ensi Ayinzabyonna, lwaki mulimu obulemu, gamba nga embuyaga ez’amaanyi, musisi, okuzikizibwa kw’enjuba n’omwezi, obulumi, okubonaabona, okufa, n’ebiringa ebyo?” Obusirusiru bw’okunenya kuno bufaanana n’obw’omuntu atayigirizibwa anenya ennyumba etannaggwa kuzimbibwa oba ekifaananyi ekitannaggwa. Oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera, bw’abiraba nga biwedde ddala, akwatibwa ensonyi olw’obusirusiru bwe, era ku nkomerero abitendereza. Bw’atyo ne Katonda teyawa nsi eno mu lunaku lumu engeri yaayo ey’omulembe guno, so teritukirira mu lunaku lumu. Obutonde bwonna bugenda mu maaso okutuuka ku kutuukirira, era singa kyali kisoboka omuntu w’ensi eno okulaba okuva ewala n’amaaso ga Katonda ensi etuukiridde omutali bulemu bwonna, naye yandivuunamye mu kutendereza mu maaso ge n’agamba nti, “byonna by’akoze nga birungi nnyo.” (Olubereberye 1:31).

7. Omwoyo gw’omuntu gubeera mu mubiri ng’akaana k’enkoko bwe kabeera mu kikuta ky’eggi. Singa kyali kisoboka okubuulira ekinyonyi ekiri munda mu kikuta nti ebweru waakyo waliyo ensi ennene ennyo egazi, erimu ebibala n’ebimuli ebya buli ngeri, emigga n’ensozi ennene ez’ekitalo, nti ne nnyaakyo ali eyo, era nti kijja kulaba bino byonna bwe kinaaba kiteereddwa okuva mu kikuta kyakyo, tekyandisobodde kukitegeera wadde okukikkiriza. Ne bwe wandibaddewo akibuulira nti ebyoya byakyo n’amaaso gaakyo, kaakano ebyetegefu okukozesebwa, bijja kukisobozesa okulaba n’okubuuka, tekyandikikkirizza, so tewandisobodde kubaawo bukakafu bwonna okutuusa nga kivudde mu kikuta kyakyo.

Mu ngeri y’emu waliwo bangi abatali bakakafu ku bulamu obugenda okujja n’okubeerawo kwa Katonda, kubanga tebasobola kulaba wala okusukka omubiri guno ogw’ennyama ogufaanana ekikuta, n’ebirowoozo byabwe, ng’ebiwaawaatiro ebinafu, tebisobola kubatwala kusukka nsalo enfunda ez’obwongo. Amaaso gaabwe amanafu tegasobola kuzuula bugagga obwo obutaggwaawo era obutafuuka Katonda bwe yategekera abo abamwagala (Isaaya 64:4; 65:17). Ekisaanyizo ekyetaagisa okutuuka ku bulamu buno obutaggwaawo kye kino, nti nga tukyali mu mubiri guno tufune okuva eri Omwoyo Omutukuvu olw’okukkiriza ebbugumu eryo eriwa obulamu akaana k’enkoko ke kafuna okuva eri nnyaako, bwe kitaba bwe kityo waliwo akabi k’okufa n’okufiirwa okw’olubeerera.

8. Ate bangi bagamba nti ekintu, oba obulamu, obulina entandikwa kiteekwa okuba n’enkomerero. Kino si kituufu, kubanga Ayinzabyonna asobola, nga bw’ayagala, okukola okuva mu bwereere ekintu ekiriwo, tasobola era olw’ekigambo eky’obuyinza bwe okuwa obutafa ekyo kye yakola? Bw’aba tasobola, tasobola kuyitibwa Ayinzabyonna. Obulamu mu nsi muno bulabika ng’obuyinza okuvunda n’okuzikirira, kubanga bufugibwa ebintu ebyo nabyo byennyini ebikyuka era ebivunda. Naye singa obulamu buno bwateebwa okuva mu bintu bino ebikyukakyuka era ebivunda, ne buteekebwa wansi w’okulabirira kwa Katonda ow’olubeerera atakyuka, ye nsulo n’ensibuko y’obulamu obutaggwaawo, bwandiwonye mu nkonde z’okufa ne butuuka ku lubeerera.

Ku abo abanzikiriza, “Nziwa obulamu obutaggwaawo, era tezigenda kuzikirira. Tewali n’omu ayinza kuzisikula mu mikono gyange” (Yokaana 10:28). “Nze … Mukama Katonda, … oyo aliwo, eyabaawo era alikomawo, Ayinzabyonna.” (Okubikkulirwa 1:8).

fields.title: Ekibi n’Obulokozi
fields.body_html:
Ekitundu I

Omuyigirizwa,—Mukama, kitegeerekeka eri kumpi buli muntu nti okujeemera Katonda n’okulekera awo okumusinza kye kibi, era ekivaamu eky’okufa kirabikira mu mbeera ensi gy’erimu kaakano. Naye ekibi kye ki ddala tekitegeerekeka bulungi. Mu maaso ddala ga Katonda Ayinzabyonna, nga kiwakanya by’ayagala, era mu nsi ye yennyini, ekibi kyajja kitya?

Mukama,—1. Ekibi kwe kusuula eri by’ayagala Katonda n’okubeera mu bulamu ng’omuntu bw’ayagala ye, ng’aleka ekyo ekituufu era ekikkirizibwa asobole okumalawo okwegomba kwe, ng’alowooza nti bw’atyo ajja kufuna essanyu. Naye bw’akola bw’atyo tafuna ssanyu lya ddala wadde okunyumirwa okw’amazima. Ekibi tekirina bwakyo ku bwakyo, n’olwekyo tewali ayinza kukyogerako nti waliwo eyakitonda. Lwe linnya bunnya ery’embeera. Waliwo Omutonzi omu yekka era mulungi, era Omutonzi omulungi teyandisobodde kutonda kintu kibi, kubanga okukola bw’atyo kyandibadde kiwakanya obutonde bwe bwennyini. Era okuggyako Omutonzi oyo omu, tewali mulala eyandisobodde kutonda kibi. Setaani asobola kwonoona bwonoonyi ekyo ekyamala okutondebwa, naye talina maanyi ga kutonda kintu kyonna. Bwe kityo ekibi si kitundu ku bitonde, so tekirina kubeerawo kwakyo ku bwakyo nti kyandiyinzizza okutondebwa. Kye kimu bumu embeera ey’obulimba era ezikiriza.

Ng’ekyokulabirako, omusana kintu ekiriwo ddala, naye ekizikiza si bwe kiri; kye kimu bumu embeera, obutabaawo bwa musana. Bwe kityo ekibi oba obubi si kintu ekibeerawo ku bwakyo, wabula kwe kubulawo oba obutabaawo bw’obulungi. Embeera eno enzirugavu ey’obubi ya ntiisa nnyo, kubanga olw’okubeera kwayo bangi babula ekkubo ettuufu, era bwe bamenyekera ku njazi za Setaani bagwa mu kizikiza kya ggeyeena ne babula. Kyennava, nze ali Omusana gw’ensi, nnalabisibwa mu mubiri, abo abanneesiga baleme okuzikirira, kubanga mbawonya okuva mu buyinza bw’ekizikiza ne mbatuusa nga balamu mu mwalo ogwo ogw’omu ggulu ogwegombebwa, omutali linnya wadde akabonero k’ekizikiza (Okubikkulirwa 21:23; 22:5).

2. Obuuza engeri embeera eno enzirugavu ey’ekibi gye yajjamu mu maaso ddala ga Mukama w’ebitonde. Yajja kubanga Setaani n’abantu, ku bwabwe, mu ngeri etakkirizibwa era enkyamu, baanoonya okutuukiriza okwegomba kwabwe. Era bw’obuuza lwaki Katonda teyatonda muntu mu ngeri nti tasobola kugwa mu mbeera ng’eyo, okuddamu kuli nti singa yakolebwa ng’ekyuma, teyandisobodde kutuuka ku mbeera eyo ey’essanyu etuukibwako bwokka ng’omuntu akola nga bw’alonze ye. Adamu ne Kaawa baagwa mu nkwe n’obulimba bwa Setaani kubanga mu mbeera yaabwe etaaliimu kibi tebaamanya nti waliwo ebintu ng’obulimba n’okulimbalimba. Ng’ekyo tekinnabaawo, Setaani yennyini teyali amanyi nti amalala gabaawo, ago olw’ago kwe yasuulibwa okuva mu ggulu, kubanga nga ye tannabaawo tewaali kintu ng’amalala. Era newaakubadde ng’embeera eno ey’ekibi yajja mu bantu ne mu Setaani, Katonda olw’amaanyi ge ag’obuyinza bwonna embeera eyo agiwadde endabika empya, n’okuva mu yo yennyini n’aggyamu ebivaamu ebisingayo obulungi.

Ekisooka, okwagala kwa Katonda okutaliiko kkomo kwalabisibwa mu kufuuka omuntu n’okununula, okwandisigadde nga kukwekeddwa singa embeera yali ndala; ate eky’okubiri, abo abanunuddwa, bwe bamala okuloza obukaawu bw’ekibi, bajja kunyumirwa nnyo essanyu ery’omu ggulu, nga bwe kiri nti oluvannyuma lw’okuloza ekikaawa obuwoomi bw’omubisi gw’enjuki busanyusa nnyo. Kubanga mu ggulu tebakyayonoona, wabula mu buwombeefu ne mu kwagala okw’obuwulize baweereza Kitaabwe Katonda, era babeera naye mu ssanyu emirembe n’emirembe.

3. Abantu banyiikira okuzuula ensobi mu njuba ne mu mwezi, gamba amabala n’okuzikizibwa, naye amabala n’okuzikizibwa kw’ekibi tebabifaako. Okuva ku kino oyinza okupima obunene bw’ekizikiza ekyo ekiri mu bantu, ng’omusana gwennyini gwe balina kizikiza (Matayo 6:23). Ng’omubiri gw’omugenge olw’obulwadde bwe bwe gufuuka ogutawulira n’ogutategeera, bwe gutyo omutima n’ebirowoozo by’omuntu olw’ekibi bifuuka ebizito era ebitawulira, ne bitamuleetera kwenyinyala wadde obulumi. Naye ekiseera kijja kutuuka lw’alizuukuka n’alaba okuzikiriza kwakyo okw’entiisa, olwo walibaawo okukaaba n’okuluma obujiji.

4. Bangi abannyikiddwa mu kibi tebamanyi buzito bwakyo, ng’omuntu ebbira mu mazzi bw’ayinza okuba n’amazzi ttani n’ettani waggulu we, naye n’atamanya n’akatono buzito bwago okutuusa lw’afuuyirwa n’afa. Naye oyo ava mu mazzi n’agezaako okutwalako amalala amangu ddala azuula obuzito bwago, ne bw’asitula matono atya; era oyo, bw’azuula omugugu gw’ekibi kye, n’ajja gye ndi ng’yenenya, ajja kufuna ekiwummulo eky’amazima ku bwereere, kubanga abo ab’engeri eyo be nzija okunoonya n’okulokola (Matayo 11:28; Lukka 19:10).

5. Tekyetaagisa buli kitundu kyonna eky’omubiri kufuuka ekitalina mugaso era ekinafu okufa nga tekunnatuuka. Obunafu oba okukubwa ku mutima oba ku bwongo kumala okukomya obulamu, ne bwe biba nti ebitundu by’omubiri ebirala binywevu era biramu bulungi. Bwe kityo ekibi kimu olw’obutwa bwakyo ku birowoozo n’omutima kimala okwonoona obulamu obw’omwoyo, si obw’omuntu omu yekka, wabula obw’amaka gonna oba eggwanga lyonna, wadde ensi yonna ey’abantu. Ekibi kya Adamu kyali bwe kityo. Naye ng’ekigambo kimu okuva gye ndi bwe kyasobola okuggya Laazaalo mu ntaana, bwe kityo kimala okuwa bonna obulamu obutaggwaawo.

6. Oluusi kibaawo nti ensolo oba ekinyonyi, oluvannyuma lw’okumala ebbanga eddene n’abantu, kiddayo mu kika kyakyo, naye ebyo mu kifo ky’okukyaniriza, ne bikirumba ne bikitta, olw’ensonga nti olw’okumala ebbanga eddene nga kibeera n’abantu era kibamanyidde, empisa zaakyo n’engeri yaakyo ey’obulamu bikyuse ddala. Nga ensolo bwe zitakkiriza mu kibiina kyazo ezo ez’ekika kyazo ezakwatibwako abantu, abatukuvu ne bamalayika mu ggulu bayinza batya okwaniriza aboonoonyi abo abaabeeranga mu nkolagana ey’oku lusegere n’abantu ababi? Kino tekitegeeza nti abatukuvu ne bamalayika tebalina kwagala eri abantu aboonoonyi, wabula embeera entukuvu ey’omu ggulu yennyini ejja kunyinyaza abantu ng’abo. Kubanga kya lwatu, nga mu nsi muno aboonoonyi bwe batayagala kubeera wamu na bantu balungi, banaasanyuka batya nga bali nabo emirembe gyonna? Gye bali eggulu ery’engeri eyo lyandibanyinyazizza nga ggeyeena yennyini.

Tolowooza nti Katonda oba abantu be bajja kugoba aboonoonyi mu ggulu babasuule mu ggeyeena, kubanga Katonda, ali Okwagala, tasuulangako muntu yenna mu ggeyeena, era taliyinza kukikola. Bulamu obucaafu obw’omwonoonyi bwe bujja okumutwala mu ggeyeena. Ng’enkomerero y’obulamu tennasembeza ggulu ne ggeyeena kumpi naffe, edda ddala mu mutima gwa buli muntu, ng’obutonde bwe obulungi oba obubi bwe buli, mwateekebwamu eggulu lye oba ggeyeena ye. N’olwekyo buli ayagala okuwonyezebwa okuva mu kubonaabona okwo okw’olubeerera, yeenenye ddala ebibi bye, ampe omutima gwe, alyoke olw’okubeerawo kwange naye n’olw’okukolera mu ye kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, afuuke omwana w’obwakabaka bwa Katonda emirembe gyonna.

7. Ajeemera kabaka oba gavumenti mu nsi muno ayinza okuwonya obulamu bwe ng’addukira mu nsi endala, naye ajeemera Katonda anaaddukira wa okuwona? Buli gy’anaagenda, ne mu ggulu oba mu ggeyeena, ajja kusanga Katonda ng’ali eyo bulijjo (Zabbuli 139:7-8). Obukuumi bwe ajja kubufuna mu kwenenya kwokka n’okwewaayo eri Mukama we.

8. Eri Adamu ne Kaawa ebikoola by’omutiini byali tebimala kubabikka, Katonda kyeyava abawa ebyambalo eby’amaliba. Bwe kityo n’ebikolwa ebirungi eby’omuntu tebirina mugaso, ng’ebikoola by’omutiini, okumuwonya obusungu obugenda okujja. Tewali kirimala okuggyako ekyambalo kyange eky’obutuukirivu.

9. Ekiwojjolo tekirowooza ku maanyi ga muliro ag’okwokya n’okuzikiriza, naye olw’okusikirizibwa okumasamasa kwagwo kigwa mu gwo ne kifa. Bw’atyo omuntu, nga tafaayo ku maanyi g’ekibi ag’okuzikiriza n’ag’obutwa, era ng’awulira okusikiriza kwakyo kwokka, afubutukira mu kuzikirira kwe okw’olubeerera. Naye omusana gwange guwonya omwonoonyi okufa, ne gumuwa obulamu n’essanyu eritaggwaawo. Omuntu yatondebwa ng’asobola okwetwalira ekirabo eky’omuwendo eky’omusana gwange ogw’amazima.

10. Ekibi si kirooto wadde ekintu eky’okulowooza obulowooza, wabula mu mbeera eno ey’ekizikiza eky’omwoyo, olw’okukozesa okwagala okubi okw’omuntu, ensigo ennamu ez’obubi ng’ezo zaazaalibwa ezigenda okwonoona omwoyo gwe emirembe gyonna era ku nkomerero ne zigusaanyaawo—ng’ennyonyo bw’esaanyaawo mu kaseera katono ennyo obulungi bw’omuntu emirembe gyonna, n’ebufuula obubi obw’entiisa. Nga Katonda bwe yatatonda bubi, bw’atyo teyatonda ndwadde n’obulumi obw’omubiri. Bye bivaamu byokka eby’obutonde olw’obujeemu bw’omuntu. Obulumi n’endwadde nabyo si bintu bya kulowooza bulowooza, wabula bye bibala eby’okungulu ebirabika eby’obulwadde obukwekeddwa obutalabika obw’ekibi, ka kibe kibi kya muntu yennyini oba eky’amaka g’abeeramu. Ab’omu maka bano bonna bwe beenenya ne begatta nange, omusaayi gwange oguwonya gutambula mu bonna, ne guwonya endwadde zaabwe zonna ez’omunda ezitalabika, ne gubawa obulamu obulungi emirembe n’emirembe. Olw’embeera eyo ey’obulamu obulungi omuntu kwe yatondebwa, alyoke abeere mu ssanyu emirembe gyonna ne Mukama we era Omuyigiriza we.

Ekitundu II

Omuyigirizwa,—Mukama, mu nnaku zino abayivu abamu n’abagoberezi baabwe batwala okutangirira kwo n’okununulibwa olw’omusaayi nga tebirina makulu era tebirina mugaso, era bagamba nti Kristo yali muyigiriza mukulu bukulu era ekyokulabirako eri obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo, era nti obulokozi n’essanyu ery’olubeerera byesigama ku kufuba kwaffe ffennyini ne ku bikolwa byaffe ebirungi.

Mukama,—1. Tewerabiranga nti ebirowoozo eby’omwoyo n’eby’eddiini tebikwatagana nnyo na mutwe nga bwe bikwatagana n’omutima, ye yeekaalu ya Katonda, era omutima bwe gujjula okubeerawo kwa Katonda, n’omutwe nagwo gufuna omusana. Kubanga amagezi n’amaaso ag’okutegeera tebirina mugaso awatali musana gwa mazima, ng’amaaso ag’omubiri bwe gatalina mugaso awatali musana gwa misana. Mu kizikiza omuntu ayinza okulowooza nti omuguwa musota, ng’abagezi b’ensi eno bwe bakyamya amazima ag’omwoyo ne babuza abantu abatategeera nnyo. Bw’atyo Setaani bwe yali alimbalimba Kaawa teyakozesa ndiga wadde ejjiba, wabula omusota, ogwasinga ebisolo byonna obukujjukujju. Bw’atyo atwala amagezi g’abagezi n’obukugu bw’abayivu, n’abifuula ebikozesebwa ebituukirawo ku kigendererwa kye. Naye tekimala kuba muyivu era mugezi; omuntu alina n’okuba n’obutaliiko musango bwa jjiba, kyenvudde njogera nti, “Mubeere bagezigezi ng’emisota, era abataliiko kya kunenyezebwa ng’amayiba.” (Matayo 10:16).

2. Omusaalaba gwange n’okutangirira kwange bikolera abakkiriza kye kimu omusota ogw’ekikomo kye gwakolera Abayisirayiri, kubanga buli eyagutunuuliranga n’eriiso ery’okukkiriza yawonanga (Okubala 21:9; Yokaana 3:14-15). Naye waaliwo abamu, mu kifo ky’okukkiriza, abaagulowooza ng’ekikomo bukomo, ne batandika okugunenya nga bagamba nti, “Singa Musa yatuwa eddagala eriziyiza obutwa, oba singa yatuwa eddagala ery’amaanyi oba eddagala ery’enjawulo ku misota gino egy’obutwa, ekyo kyandibadde kituufu okukkiriza, naye omulongooti guno gulina maanyi ki ku butwa?” Bonna baafa. Ne mu nnaku zino, abo abawakanya engeri y’obulokozi Katonda gye yateekawo bajja kuzikirira mu butwa bw’ekibi kyabwe.

3. Omuvubuka yagwa mu kagwa akawanvu n’alumizibwa nnyo, n’afiirwa omusaayi mungi nnyo n’atuuka okumpi n’okufa. Kitaawe bwe yamutwala eri omusawo, omusawo n’agamba nti, “Obulamu buli mu musaayi, era omusaayi gw’omuvubuka ono guweddemu; naye bwe wanaabaawo omuntu eyeetegefu okuwaayo obulamu bwe, ayinza okuwona, bwe kitaba bwe kityo ajja kufa.” Kitaawe, omutima gwe ogwali gujjudde okwagala eri mutabani we, n’awaayo omusaayi gwe ye, era bwe gwateekebwa mu misuwa gy’omuvubuka n’awona. Omuntu yagwa okuva ku lusozi olw’obutukuvu, era agalamidde ng’amenyese era ng’alina ebiwundu olw’ebibi bye, era olw’ebiwundu ebyo obulamu bwe obw’omwoyo bugenze buggwaamu, era ali kumpi n’okufa. Naye ku lw’abo abanzikiriza nfuka omusaayi gwange ogw’olubeerera era ogw’omwoyo, balyoke bawonyezebwe okufa bafune obulamu obutaggwaawo. Kino kye kyandeeta, babe n’obulamu, era babe nabwo mu bujjuvu (Yokaana 10:10), era bwe batyo babeere balamu emirembe n’emirembe.

4. Mu biseera eby’edda abantu baagaanibwa okunywa omusaayi gw’ensolo, oba okulya emmere ezimu, nga kikkirizibwa nti bwe batyo bajja kuwona endwadde ezimu; era nti, okuva omuntu bw’alina omubiri ogw’ensolo, empisa ze ez’ekisolo zireme kunywezebwa olw’okulya ennyama n’okunywa omusaayi. Naye kaakano “Omubiri gwange kye kyokulya ddala n’omusaayi gwange kye kyokunywa ddala.” (Yokaana 6:55), kubanga biwa obulamu obw’omwoyo, era mu byo mwe mufunibwa obulamu obutuukiridde n’essanyu ery’omu ggulu n’okujaguza.

5. Okusonyiyibwa ebibi tekitegeeza bulokozi obujjuvu, kubanga obwo bujja bwokka nga waliwo okusumululwa okutuukiridde okuva mu kibi. Kubanga kiyinzika omuntu okufa olw’obulwadde bw’ekibi kye, newaakubadde ng’afunye okusonyiyibwa okujjuvu ku lwakyo. Ng’ekyokulabirako, waaliwo omusajja eyakosebwa obwongo olw’obulwadde obwali bumaze ebbanga ddene, era bwe yali mu mbeera eyo n’alumba omusajja omulala n’amutta. Bwe yasalirwa omusango gw’okufa, ab’eŋŋanda ze ne bannyonnyola embeera eyaliwo ne bamwegayiririra asaasirwe, era n’asonyiyibwa ekibi ky’obutemu. Naye mikwano gye nga tebannatuuka gy’ali n’amawulire amalungi, mazima nga bakyali mu kkubo, yali amaze okufa olw’obulwadde obwamuleetera okutta.

Okusonyiyibwa okwo kwagasa ki omutemu? Obukuumi bwe obwa ddala bwandibadde okuwonyezebwa obulwadde bwe, olwo yandibadde n’essanyu erya ddala mu kusonyiyibwa kwe. Kyennava ndabisibwa mu mubiri, ndyoke mponye abakkiriza abeenenya okuva mu bulwadde bw’ekibi, mu kibonerezo kyakyo ne mu kufa; bwe ntyo ne nzigyawo ensibuko n’ekivaamu byombi. Tebalifiira mu bibi byabwe, kubanga ndibalokola (Matayo 1:21), era balisomoka okuva mu kufa ne bafuuka abasika b’obulamu obutaggwaawo.

6. Eri abantu bangi obulamu bujjudde obulabe, era bafaanana omuyizzi oyo eyalaba ekisenge ky’enjuki ku ttabi ly’omuti eryali lyewunzise waggulu w’omugga. Bwe yalinnya, n’atandika okunyumirwa omubisi gw’enjuki, nga tamanyi n’akatono nti yali mu bulabe bw’okufa, kubanga mu mugga wansi we mwalimu ggoonya ng’eyasamye akamwa ng’erindirira okumulya, ate okwetooloola entobo y’omuti ekibinja ky’emisege kyali kikuŋŋaanye nga kirindirira akke. Ekisinga obubi, omuti gwe yali atuddeko gwali gulumiddwa ekiwuka ku mirandira era nga gwetegefu okugwa. Mu kaseera katono ne gugwa ddala, omuyizzi ataali mwegendereza n’afuuka omuyiggo gwa ggoonya. Bwe kityo n’omwoyo gw’omuntu, ogubeera mu mubiri, gunyumirwa okumala akaseera katono amasanyu ag’ekibi ag’obulimba era agayita amangu agakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu kisenge ky’enjuki eky’obwongo, nga tegulowoozaako nti guli wakati mu kibira kino eky’entiisa eky’ensi. Eyo Setaani gy’atudde nga mwetegefu okugutemaatema, ne ggeyeena ng’eringa ggoonya erindirira ng’esamye akamwa okugumira, ate, ekisinga byonna obubi, akawuka akatono akatalabika ak’ekibi kalidde emirandira gyennyini egy’omubiri n’obulamu. Amangu ago emmeeme egwa n’efuuka omuyiggo gwa ggeyeena emirembe gyonna. Naye omwonoonyi ajja gye ndi ndimuwonya ekibi, ne Setaani, ne ggeyeena, era ndimuwa essanyu ery’olubeerera, “essanyu lyammwe tewali n’omu aliribaggyako” (Yokaana 16:22).

7. Setaani n’enjogera ey’obukujjukujju n’ebisikiriza asikira abantu gy’ali n’abamira, ng’omusota bwe gusikiriza obunyonyi obutono olw’amaanyi g’eriiso lyagwo erimasamasa, ne gubufuula omuyiggo gwagwo. Naye abo abanzikiriza mbawa okuwona okuva eri omusota ogwo ogw’edda n’okuva mu bisikiriza by’ensi eno ezikiriza emmeeme. Mbateera ddala, ng’ekinyonyi bwe kiwakanya mu bwangu amaanyi agasika agali mu nsi ne kibuuka nga kyetaaye mu bbanga eggazi, nabo babuuke ku biwaawaatiro by’okusaba ne batuuka ku nkomerero mu kifo eky’obukuumi n’amaka ag’omutima gwabwe amaagalwa, nga basikiriziddwa obuwoomi bw’okwagala kwange.

8. Ng’omuntu alina ekikulukusa bw’alaba buli kintu nga kya kyenvu, bwe gatyo n’amazima gennyini eri omwonoonyi n’eri omufirosoofo gatwala endabika n’engeri y’ekibi kye oba ey’endowooza ze, era tekyewuunyisa nnyo abantu ng’abo bwe beeyongerayo omutendera ne bantwala ng’omwonoonyi nga bo. Naye omulimu gwange, kwe kulokola aboonoonyi, tegwesigama ku ndowooza ennungi ey’ensi, wabula bulijjo gugenda mu maaso mu kkubo lyagwo nga teguliiko kiguziyiza mu bulamu bw’abakkiriza. Nga Leevi, bwe yali akyali mu ntumbwe za Ibulayimu, bwe yampa ekimu eky’ekkumi newaakubadde nga yali tannazaalibwa, bwe kityo emirembe gyonna egy’abakkiriza girina mu nze, eyaweebwayo ku musaalaba, okutangirira n’omutango olw’ebibi byabwe, newaakubadde nga mu kiseera ekyo baali tebannaba na kuzaalibwa; kubanga obulokozi buno bwa mawanga gonna ag’abantu mu nsi.

9. Ekigambo kino, nti omuntu olw’okufuba kwe ye n’olw’ebikolwa ebirungi asobola okufuna obulokozi, kya busirusiru era tekirina magezi, omuntu nga tannazaalibwa buggya. Abafuzi b’ensi n’abayigiriza b’empisa ennungi bagamba nti, “Fuuka mulungi ng’okola ebirungi,” naye kino kye njogera nze nti, “Sooka ofuuke mulungi ggwe kennyini nga tonnakola bikolwa birungi.” Obulamu obwo obuggya era obulungi bwe bumala okutandikibwa, ebikolwa ebirungi bijja kuvaamu mu ngeri ey’obutonde.

Musirusiru yekka y’ayinza okugamba nti omuti omukaawa, bwe gunaabalanga ebibala bulijjo, ku nkomerero gujja kufuuka omuwoomu. Mazima omuti omukaawa guyinza okufuuka omuwoomu nga gusimbibwako ku muti omuwoomu, obulamu n’engeri ez’omuti omuwoomu ne biyingira mu mukaawa n’obukaawu bwagwo obw’obutonde ne buggwaawo. Kino kye tuyita ekitonde ekiggya. Bw’atyo n’omwonoonyi ayinza okuba n’okwegomba okukola ekituufu, naye ekivaamu kyokka ne kiba kibi; naye bw’ayenenya n’asimbibwa mu nze olw’okukkiriza, omuntu omukadde ali mu ye afa, n’afuuka ekitonde ekiggya. Olwo okuva mu bulamu buno obuggya obulina ensibuko yaabwo mu bulokozi, ebikolwa ebirungi bivaamu ng’ebibala, era ebibala bino bibeerawo emirembe gyonna.

10. Waliwo bangi abayize mu bye bayiseemu nti obulungi bw’omuntu obw’obutonde tebusobola kuwa mirembe gya mazima mu mutima, so tebusobola kumuwa bukakafu bwa bulokozi wadde obulamu obutaggwaawo. Omuvubuka eyajja gye ndi ng’anoonya obulamu obutaggwaawo kyakulabirako ekirungi. Endowooza ye eyasooka ku nze yali nkyamu, ng’eyo ey’abamu ku bagezigezi b’ensi n’abagoberezi baabwe mu nnaku zino. Yandowooza okuba omu ku bayigiriza abo abafaanana entaana ezaasiigibwa langi enjeru, abatalina mu bulamu bwabwe kafuufu ka bulungi bwa mazima. Kyennava mmugamba nti, “Lwaki ombuuza ebikwata ku birungi? Omulungi ali omu.” Naye n’atalaba mu nze Omugabi omu yekka ow’obulungi n’obulamu; era bwe nnagezaako okumuyingiza mu bukwano bwange, mmufuule omuntu omulungi ddala, mmuwe obulamu, n’anakuwala n’andeka. Naye obulamu bwe bulaga ddala ekintu kimu, era kye kino nti okukwata amateeka n’obulungi bwe tebyamumatiza wadde okumuwa obukakafu bw’obulamu obutaggwaawo. Singa ebikolwa bye ebirungi byamuwa emirembe teyandizze kumbuuza, oba bwe yandizze teyandindese ng’anakuwadde, wabula, ng’akkirizza ebigambo byange, yandigenze ng’ajaguza.

Bwe waayitawo ebbanga ttono, omuvubuka Pawulo n’ammanya, era okwegomba kw’omutima gwe ne kutuukirizibwa ddala. Mu kifo ky’okukyuka ng’anakuwadde, n’awaayo byonna bye yalina n’angoberera (Abafiripi 3:6-15). Bwe kityo buli alekera awo okwesiga obutuukirivu bwe ye n’angoberera ajja kufuna okuva gye ndi emirembe egy’amazima n’obulamu obutaggwaawo.
