fields.body_html:
Ekitundu I

Omuyigirizwa,—Oluusi ekibuuzo kino kibuuzibwa: “Okuva Katonda bw’amanyi bulungi ebyetaago byaffe, era nga amanyi engeri esinga obulungi ey’okubituukiriza, si eri abalungi bokka wabula n’eri ababi, lwaki tumusaba ku byo? Ebyetaago byaffe ka bibe bya mubiri oba bya mwoyo, tusobola olw’okusaba kwaffe okukyusa Katonda by’ayagala?”

Mukama,—1. Abo ababuuza ekibuuzo ng’ekyo balaga lwatu nti tebamanyi kusaba kye ki. Tebabeerangako mu bulamu bwa kusaba, bwe kitandibadde bwe kityo bandimanyi nti okusaba Katonda si ngeri ya kusabiriza. Okusaba tekuli mu kufuba kufuna okuva eri Katonda ebintu ebyetaagisa mu bulamu buno. Okusaba kwe kufuba okwekwata ku Katonda yennyini, Ensibuko y’obulamu, era bwe tumala okumuzuula oyo ensulo y’obulamu ne tuyingira mu kussa ekimu naye, olwo obulamu bwonna buba bwaffe era wamu naye byonna ebirifuula obulamu okutuukirira. Eri abakozi b’ebibi, Katonda, olw’okubaagala, abawa ebyetaagisa mu bulamu bwabwe mu nsi muno, naye ebyetaago byabwe eby’omwoyo tabibalaga n’akatono, kubanga tebalina bulamu bwa mwoyo.

Singa yabawa emikisa egy’omwoyo ng’egyo, tebandisobodde kugisiima. Naye abo abakkiriza baweebwa ebirabo eby’engeri zombi, okusingira ddala emikisa egy’omwoyo, era ekivaamu kiri nti mangu ddala emikisa egy’omubiri tebagifaako nnyo, wabula okwagala kwabwe bakussa ku bitalabika n’eby’omwoyo. Tetusobola kukyusa Katonda by’ayagala, naye omuntu asaba asobola okuzuula Katonda by’ayagala ku ye. Kubanga eri abantu ab’engeri eyo Katonda yeeyoleka mu kisenge eky’ekyama eky’omutima, n’assa nabo ekimu; era ebigendererwa bye eby’ekisa bwe birabisibwa nga bya bulungi bwabwe, olwo okubuusabuusa n’ebizibu bye beemulugunyako biggwaawo emirembe gyonna.

2. Okusaba, nga bwe kyandibadde, kwe kussa omukka gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era Katonda afuka Omwoyo we Omutukuvu mu bulamu bw’abo abasaba ne bafuuka “abalamu” (Olubereberye 2:7; Yokaana 20:22). Tebalifa n’akatono, kubanga Omwoyo Omutukuvu yeefuka mu mawuggwe gaabwe ag’omwoyo ng’ayita mu kusaba, n’ajjuza emyoyo gyabwe obulamu obulungi, amaanyi n’obulamu obutaggwaawo.

Katonda, ali Okwagala, yawa abantu bonna ku bwereere ebintu ebyetaagisa mu bulamu obw’omwoyo n’obw’omubiri, naye kubanga obulokozi n’Omwoyo we Omutukuvu abiwa bonna ku bwereere bwe kityo, abantu babinyooma. Naye okusaba kutuyigiriza okubitwala nga bya muwendo, kubanga byetaagisa ng’empewo n’amazzi, ebbugumu n’omusana, awatali ebyo obulamu tebusoboka. Ebintu eby’obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo Katonda yabiteekawo ku bwereere, naye abantu babinyooma nnyo ne batamwebaza Mutonzi waabwe; naye ku luuyi olulala, ebirabo bye ebya zaabu, ffeeza n’amayinja ag’omuwendo omungi, ebitono era ebifunibwa n’obuzibu bungi, babitwala nga bya muwendo nnyo, newaakubadde ng’ebintu ebyo tebisobola kumalawo njala n’ennyonta y’omubiri, so tebimatiza kwegomba kw’omutima. Bwe batyo abantu b’ensi bwe beeyisa n’obusirusiru ku bintu eby’omwoyo, naye omuntu asaba aweebwa amagezi ag’amazima n’obulamu obutaggwaawo.

3. Ensi eno eringa ennyanja engazi abantu mwe babbira ne bafiira, naye ebisolo eby’omu nnyanja bibeera mu bulamu bwabyo mu mazzi agasinga obuwanvu, kubanga oluusi bijja waggulu ku mazzi, ne byasamya obumwa bwabyo, ne bissa omukka ogumu, ogubisobozesa okubeera wansi ennyo. Bwe batyo abo abalinnya okutuuka waggulu ku nnyanja eno ey’obulamu, nga bayita mu kusaba okw’ekyama bassa omukka gw’Omwoyo wa Katonda awa obulamu, ne bafuna ne mu nsi muno obulamu n’obukuumi.

4. Newaakubadde ng’ebyennyanja bimala obulamu bwabyo bwonna mu mazzi ag’omunnyo ag’ennyanja, naye byo byennyini tebifuuka bya munnyo, kubanga birimu obulamu; bw’atyo omuntu asaba, newaakubadde ng’alina okubeera mu nsi eno eyonooneddwa ekibi, asigala nga talina kamogo ka kibi, kubanga olw’okusaba obulamu bwe bukuumibwa.

5. Ng’amazzi ag’omunnyo ag’ennyanja bwe gasikibwa waggulu olw’ebimyanso eby’ebbugumu eby’enjuba, ne gagenda gafuuka ebire mpolampola, era bwe gafuuka bwe gatyo amazzi amawoomu era agawewula, ne gatonnya ng’enkuba ku nsi (kubanga amazzi g’ennyanja bwe galinnya waggulu galeka emabega omunnyo gwago n’obukaawu bwago), bwe kityo ebirowoozo n’okwegomba kw’omuntu asaba bwe birinnya waggulu ng’olufu oluva mu mmeeme, ebimyanso by’Enjuba ey’Obutuukirivu bibirongoosa okuva mu kamogo konna ak’ekibi, n’okusaba kwe ne kufuuka ekire ekinene ekikka okuva mu ggulu ng’enkuba ey’omukisa, ne kireetera bangi ku nsi okuwewulwa.

6. Ng’ekinyonyi eky’omu mazzi bwe kimala obulamu bwakyo nga kiwuga mu mazzi, naye bwe kiba kibuuka ebyoya byakyo nga bikalu ddala, bwe batyo abantu abasaba babeera mu nsi muno, naye ekiseera bwe kituuka okubuuka waggulu bava mu nsi eno eyonooneddwa ekibi ne batuuka nga tebaliiko bbala wadde ekko mu maka gaabwe ag’ekiwummulo eky’olubeerera.

7. Ekyombo, nga bwe kisaanidde, kifo kyakyo kiri mu mazzi, naye amazzi okuyingira mu kyombo tekisaana era kya bulabe. Bwe kityo omuntu okubeera mu nsi muno kituufu era kirungi gy’ali n’eri abalala, kubanga, bw’asigala ng’aseeyeeya waggulu, ajja kusobola okubayamba okutuuka wamu naye ku mwalo ogw’obulamu. Naye ensi okufuna ekkubo okuyingira mu mutima gwe kitegeeza kufa na kuzikirira. N’olwekyo omuntu asaba bulijjo omutima gwe aguterekera oyo eyagubumba okuba yeekaalu ye, era bw’atyo mu nsi muno ne mu eyo egenda okujja awummula mu mirembe ne mu bukuumi.

8. Ffenna tumanyi nti awatali mazzi tekisoboka kubeera mulamu; naye bwe tubbira wansi waago tufuuyirwa ne tufa. Wadde nga twetaaga okukozesa amazzi n’okuganywa, tetusaanidde kugagwamu ne tubbira wansi waago. N’olwekyo ensi n’ebintu by’ensi birina okukozesebwa n’amagezi, kubanga awatali byo obulamu si buzibu bwokka wabula tebusoboka. Kye kyennyini kye yava atonda ensi, abantu basobole okugikozesa, naye abantu tebasaanidde kugibbiramu, kubanga bwe batyo omukka gw’okusaba guyimirira ne bazikirira.

9. Singa olw’okulekera awo okubeera mu bulamu obw’okusaba obulamu bw’omwoyo butandika okuggwaamu amaanyi, olwo ebintu by’ensi ebigendererwa okuba eby’omugaso bifuuka ebirumya era ebizikiriza. Enjuba olw’omusana gwayo n’ebbugumu lyayo ereetera ebimera byonna okubeera ebiramu n’okukula obulungi, era ate y’emu ebireetera okukala n’okufa. Empewo nayo ewa ebiramu byonna obulamu n’amaanyi, naye yo yennyini y’ensonga y’okuvunda kwabyo. N’olwekyo “Mutunule nga bwe musaba.”

10. Tusaanidde okubeera mu nsi muno mu ngeri nti newaakubadde nga tuli mu yo, tetuli ba yo, olwo ebintu by’ensi eno mu kifo ky’okutulumya bijja kuba bya mugaso, era bijja kuyamba okukula kw’obulamu obw’omwoyo; naye ku kakwakkulizo kano kokka, nti omwoyo bulijjo gukyusiza amaaso gaagwo eri Enjuba ey’Obutuukirivu. Bwe kityo oluusi kibaawo nti mu kifo eky’ettaka ery’obucaafu n’ekko ebimuli ne bimera ne bikula bulungi, n’akawoowo akalungi ak’ebimuli ne kasinga ekivundu ekibi eky’ekifo ekyo. Ebimera, nga bikyukira enjuba, bifuna okuva gy’ali omusana n’ebbugumu, n’obucaafu mu kifo ky’okulumya ebimera bibigimusa ne bibiyamba okukula n’okwegaziya. Bw’atyo n’omuntu asaba, bw’asaba akyusiza omutima gwe gye ndi, n’afuna okuva gye ndi omusana n’ebbugumu, era wakati mu bivundu ebibi eby’ensi eno embi akawoowo akalungi ak’obulamu bwe obuggya era obutukuvu kangulumiza, era mu ye muvaamu si kawoowo kalungi kokka, wabula n’ebibala ebiribeerawo emirembe gyonna.

Ekitundu II

1. Okusaba tekitegeeza nti awatali kusaba Katonda teyanditutuwadde kintu kyonna oba nti teyandimanyi byetaago byaffe, naye kulina omugaso guno omunene, nti mu mbeera ey’okusaba emmeeme y’esinga okuba ennyetegefu okwaniriza Omugabi w’omukisa awamu n’emikisa egyo gy’ayagala okugaba. Kyekyava obujjuvu bw’Omwoyo butafukibwa ku Batume ku lunaku olusooka, wabula oluvannyuma lw’ennaku kkumi ez’okwetegeka okw’enjawulo.

Singa omuntu yaweebwa omukisa nga teyeetegekedde gwo mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, teyandigutwalidde ku muwendo gwagwo ogumala, so teyandiguwangaazizza. Ng’ekyokulabirako, kubanga Sawulo yafuna Omwoyo Omutukuvu n’obwakabaka nga tabinoonyezza, mangu ddala n’afiirwa byombi, kubanga yava waka si kufuna Mwoyo Mutukuvu wabula kunoonya ndogoyi ze ezaali zibuze (1 Samwiri 9:3; 10:11; 5:13-14; 31:4).

2. Omuntu asaba yekka y’asobola okusinza Katonda mu mwoyo ne mu mazima. Abalala bafaanana ekimera ekiwulira amangu ekyezinga bwe kikwatibwako; mu kusinza, nga bakwatiddwako okuyigiriza n’okubeerawo kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, beezinga, nga bwe kyandibadde, ne bakutamya emitwe gyabwe ne bafuuka ab’ekitiibwa, naye nga tebannaba na kuva mu kkanisa, baddamu okusanyuka ne beeyongerayo nga bwe baali.

3. Bwe tutalabirira muti oba kisaka ekibala ebibala ebirungi oba ebimuli, kijja kwonooneka kidde mu mbeera yaakyo ey’ekibira. Mu ngeri y’emu, omukkiriza bw’alekera awo okubeera mu nze olw’okulagajjalira okusaba n’obulamu obw’omwoyo, olw’obulagajjavu obwo ajja kugwa okuva mu mbeera eyo ey’omukisa, era bw’addamu okusaanawo mu makubo ge ag’edda ag’ekibi abule.

4. Bwe tulaba ekinyonyi ekiwanvu eky’omu bitoogo nga kiyimiridde nga tekyenyeenya ku lubalama lw’ekidiba oba ennyanja, tuyinza okulowooza okuva ku ngeri gye kiyimiriddemu nti kifumiitiriza ku kitiibwa kya Katonda oba ku bulungi bw’amazzi. Naye nedda! Kiyimirira awo nga tekyenyeenya okumala essaawa nnyingi, naye amangu ddala nga kirabye ekikere oba ekyennyanja ekitono, kibuukira ku kyo ne kikimira. Bwe kiri ddala n’engeri n’enkola y’abangi ku kusaba n’okufumiitiriza okw’eddiini. Nga batudde ku lubalama lw’ennyanja ya Katonda etaliiko nkomerero, tebalowooza ku bukulu bwe n’okwagala kwe, oba ku butonde bwe obw’obwakatonda obulongoosa okuva mu kibi era obukkusa emmeeme erumwa enjala, wabula bamaliddwa ddala ekirowoozo ky’okufuna ekintu kye beegomba ennyo, ekiribasobozesa okweyongera okwesanyusaamu mu by’ensi eno ebiyita amangu. Bwe batyo bakyuka ne bava ku nsulo y’emirembe egy’amazima, era bwe beennyika mu masanyu agayita ag’ensi eno, nabo bafa ne bayitawo wamu nago.

5. Amazzi n’amafuta ga petulooli byombi biva mu ttaka, era newaakubadde nga birabika nga bifaanagana era nga bye bimu, mu butonde bwabyo ne mu kigendererwa bikontana ddala, kubanga ekimu kizikiza omuliro ate ekirala kigwongera. Bwe kityo n’ensi n’obugagga bwayo, omutima n’ennyonta yaagwo eri Katonda byonna bitonde bye. Kaakano ekiva mu kugezaako okukkusa omutima n’obugagga n’amalala n’ekitiibwa eby’ensi eno kiri kye kimu ng’omuntu agezaako okuzikiza omuliro ne petulooli, kubanga omutima gusobola okufuna emirembe n’okukkuta mu oyo yekka eyagutonda era eyatonda okwegomba kwe guwulira (Zabbuli 42:1-2). N’olwekyo buli ajja gye ndi kaakano ndimuwa amazzi ago amalamu aleme okuddayo okulumwa ennyonta, wabula galifuuka mu ye ensulo y’amazzi etekalira ekulukuta okutuuka ku bulamu obutaggwaawo (Yokaana 4:14).

6. Abantu bafuba bwereere okufuna emirembe mu nsi ne mu bintu by’ensi, kubanga bye bayitamu biraga lwatu nti emirembe egy’amazima n’okumatira tebiri mu byo. Bafaanana omulenzi eyasanga katungulu n’atandika okukaggyako ebikuta, ng’asuubira okusanga ekintu munda mu kyo, ng’omuntu bw’asanga ekintu mu ssanduuko bw’aggyako ekisaanikira. Naye okusuubira kwe kwali kwa bwereere ddala, kubanga teyasanga kintu kyonna okuggyako ekikuta ekisembayo, kubanga akatungulu tekalina kirala okuggyako ebikuta ebikuŋŋaanyiziddwa wamu. Era ensi eno ne byonna ebyayo kikakasiddwa nti butaliimu bwa butaliimu (Omubuulizi 12:8), okutuusa abantu lwe balizuula ensulo ey’amazima ey’emirembe (Isaaya 55:1; Yeremiya 2:13; Okubikkulirwa 22:17).

7. Ensi efaanana ng’ekiyiifuyiifu ky’amazzi mu ddungu, era anoonya amazima, ng’asuubira okusanga ekintu ekinaamatiza omwoyo gwe oguyonta, asimbula okukinoonya naye tasanga kirala okuggyako okuggwaamu essuubi n’okuterebuka. Amazzi g’obulamu tegasobola kusangibwa mu bidiba ebyakolebwa abantu oba mu ttanka ezirimu enjatika; naye abo abansemberera mu kusaba n’omutima omulongoofu bajja kusanga mu nze, ali ensulo y’amazzi amalamu, ekyo mwe bayinza okufuna okukkuta, okuzzibwamu amaanyi n’obulamu obutaggwaawo (Isaaya 55:1; Yeremiya 2:13; Okubikkulirwa 22:17).

Omukazi yali atambula mu kkubo ery’oku lusozi ng’asitudde omwana we mu mikono gye, omwana bwe yalaba ekimuli ekirungi, n’abuuka n’amaanyi okuva mu mikono gya nnyina n’agwa ng’akulukuta wansi ku lusozi, n’akoona omutwe gwe ku lwazi, n’afiirawo. Kaakano kya lwatu ddala nti obukuumi n’okuliisibwa kw’omwana byali mu kifuba kya nnyina, so si mu bimuli ebyo ebisikiriza ebyaleeta okufa kwe. Bw’atyo bw’akola omukkiriza obulamu bwe obutali bulamu bwa kusaba. Bw’alaba amasanyu g’ensi agayita amangu era agasikiriza, yeerabira okwagala kwange n’okulabirira kwange ebisinga ennyo ebya maama, era, ng’alagajjalidde amata ago ag’omwoyo ge mmuteekerawo, abuuka okuva mu mikono gyange n’abula.

9. Okuliisa maama kw’awa kutegekeddwa mu ngeri nti tekusobola kufunibwa awatali kufuba kwonna okuva ku mwana omuwere. Bwe batyo n’abaana bange be nsitulira mu kifuba kyange tebasobola kufuna, awatali kunoonya, amata ag’omwoyo agasobola okulokola emmeeme zaabwe. Era ng’omwana bw’atalina kuyigirizibwa, wabula amanya mu butonde bwe wa n’engeri gy’ayinza okufunamu emmere ye, bwe batyo abo abazaaliddwa Omwoyo bamanya olw’amagezi ag’omwoyo ag’obutonde, so si olw’amagezi ag’ensi oba ag’abafirosoofo, engeri y’okusaba n’okufuna okuva gye ndi, Nnyaabwe ow’omwoyo, amata ag’obulamu obutaggwaawo.

10. Nnateeka mu butonde bw’omuntu enjala n’ennyonta, aleme mu bulagajjavu bwokka okwetwala nga Katonda, wabula buli lunaku ajjukizibwenga ebyetaago bye era nti obulamu bwe busibiddwa ku bulamu n’okubeerawo kw’Omuntu omu eyamutonda. Bw’atyo bw’amanyisibwa obunafu bwe n’ebyetaago bye, asobole okubeera mu nze nange mu ye, olwo bulijjo ajja kusanga mu nze essanyu lye n’okujaguza kwe.

Ekitundu III

1. Okusaba kuli, nga bwe kyandibadde, kubeera mu kwogeragana nange, era bwe kityo olw’okussa ekimu nange n’okubeera mu nze okufuuka nga nze. Waliwo ekika ky’ekiwuka ekirya era ekibeera mu muddo ne mu bikoola ebibisi ne kifuuka nga byo mu langi. Era n’eddubu eryeru ery’omu bitundu by’ensi ebinnyogovu ennyo, eribeera wakati mu muzira omweru, lirina obweru bwe bumu obw’omuzira, n’engo ey’e Bengal erina ku lususu lwayo obubonero bw’ebitoogo mw’ebeera. Bwe batyo abo, abayita mu kusaba ne babeera mu kussa ekimu nange, bagabana, wamu n’abatukuvu ne bamalayika, ku butonde bwange, era bwe babumbibwa mu kifaananyi kyange bafuuka nga nze.

2. Bwe nnasika Peetero, Yakobo ne Yokaana okussa ekimu nange okumala akaseera katono bukyali ku Lusozi, nnabalagako ku kitiibwa kyange, era ku batukuvu bonna babiri bokka, Musa ne Eriya, be baabalabikira; baasikirizibwa nnyo olw’okulaba okwo okutono okw’ekitiibwa eky’omu ggulu ne baagala okuzimba ensiisira ssatu babeere omwo (Matayo 17:1-5). Kale essanyu lyandibadde lya kitalo kyenkana ki ery’abo ababeera mu nze, era wamu n’abatukuvu ne bamalayika abatabalika ne bayingira mu ggulu lyabwe lye beegomba, ne bagabana nange ekitiibwa kyange ekijjuvu ekitamanyi kufiirwa wadde ekisiikirize ky’okukyukakyuka (Yokaana 17:24; Yakobo 1:17). Omuntu asaba taliba yekka n’akatono, wabula alibeera nange n’abatukuvu bange emirembe gyonna (Matayo 28:20; Zekkaliya 3:7-8).

3. Si kintu kikulu okufuga n’okukozesa ensolo ez’omu nsiko, eraddu, empewo n’omusana, n’amaanyi amalala ag’obutonde, naye okufuna obuyinza ku nsi ne Setaani n’omuntu yennyini, n’okwegomba kwe kwonna, mazima kye kintu ekisinga obukulu era ekyetaagisa. Abo bokka ababeera mu bulamu obw’okusaba be mpa obuyinza okuwangula amaanyi gonna ag’omulabe (Lukka 10:17, 20), ne kiba nti ne bwe baba bakyabeera mu nsi muno, babeera nange mu bifo eby’omu ggulu (Abaefeso 2:6), era Setaani bw’aba wansi nabo nga bali waggulu, tasobola n’akatono kubatuukako, wabula babeera nange emirembe gyonna mu bukuumi nga tebakankana na kutya.

Newaakubadde ng’abantu kaakano bafunye obuyinza ku maanyi g’obutonde, tebasobola kutambula kusukka nsalo za bbanga, so ng’omuntu asaba, bw’amala okuwangula Setaani n’omuntu we, asobola okutambula nga bw’ayagala mu ggulu ery’olubeerera.

4. Ng’enjuki bw’ekuŋŋaanya omubisi omuwoomu ogw’ebimuli n’egufuula omubisi gw’enjuki awatali kwonoona langi yaabyo wadde akawoowo kaabyo, bw’atyo omuntu asaba akuŋŋaanya essanyu n’amagoba okuva mu bitonde byonna ebya Katonda awatali kubikola kabi konna. Era ng’enjuki bwe zikuŋŋaanya omubisi gwazo okuva ku bimuli mu bifo ebya buli ngeri ne zigutereka mu kisenge kyazo, bw’atyo omuntu wa Katonda akuŋŋaanya ebirowoozo n’enneewulira ebiwoomu okuva mu buli kitundu ky’obutonde, era mu kussa ekimu n’Omutonzi we akuŋŋaanya mu mutima gwe omubisi gw’amazima, era mu mirembe egy’olubeerera naye mu biseera byonna ne mu bifo byonna, aloza n’essanyu omubisi omuwoomu ogwa Katonda.

5. Kaakano kye kiseera eky’okufuna n’okutereka mu bibya by’emitima gyaffe amafuta g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ng’abawala embeerera abataano ab’amagezi bwe baakola (Matayo 25:1-13); bwe kitaba bwe kityo, ng’abataano abataalina magezi, tetujja kusanga kirala okuggyako ennaku n’okuggwaamu essuubi. Era kaakano olina okukuŋŋaanya maanu ey’Essabbiiti ey’amazima, bwe kitaba bwe kityo tewajja kusigala kirala gy’oli okuggyako ennaku n’okukaaba (Okuva 16:15, 27). “Musabe ekiseera ky’okudduka kireme kutuukira mu biro bya butiti,” kwe kugamba, mu kiseera eky’obuyinike obungi oba mu nnaku ez’enkomerero, “oba ku lunaku lwa Ssabbiiti,” kwe kugamba, obufuzi obw’emyaka olukumi obw’ekiwummulo eky’olubeerera, kubanga omukisa ng’ogwo teguliddamu kubaawo (Matayo 24:20).

Ng’embeera y’obudde bw’ereeta enkyukakyuka mu ndabika, mu langi ne mu ngeri y’okukula kw’ebimera n’ebimuli, bwe batyo abo abakuuma okussa ekimu nange bakulaakulana mu butonde bwabwe obw’omwoyo mu mpisa, mu ndabika ne mu mbeera y’omutima; era bwe beeyambulamu omuntu omukadde bakyusibwa ne bafuuka ekifaananyi kyange ekyekitiibwa ekitavunda.

N’engalo yange nnawandiika ku ttaka embeera ey’ekibi eya buli omu ku abo, abataafaayo ku bucaafu bwabwe obw’omunda, abaaleeta omukazi eyakwatibwa ng’ayenda asalirwe omusango, ne kiba nti ne bamuleka omu ku omu ne bagenda nga bakwatiddwa ensonyi era nga baswadde. Era n’engalo yange ndaga mu kyama abaweereza bange ebiwundu byabwe eby’ekibi, era bwe beenenya, nga nkozesa engalo eyo yennyini mbawonya; era ng’omwana bw’akwata engalo ya kitaawe n’atambula naye ng’ayambibwa yo, bwe ntyo nze n’engalo yange nkulembera abaana bange mu kkubo okuva mu nsi muno okutuuka mu maka gaabwe ag’ekiwummulo n’emirembe egy’olubeerera (Yokaana 14:2-3).

7. Emirundi mingi abantu basaba Kitange mu linnya lyange, naye nga tebabeera mu nze, kwe kugamba, erinnya lyange balitwala mu kamwa kaabwe ne ku mimwa gyabwe, naye si mu mitima gyabwe ne mu bulamu bwabwe. Eyo y’ensonga lwaki tebafuna bye basaba. Naye bwe mbeera mu bo nabo mu nze, olwo kyonna kye basaba Kitange bakifuna, kubanga basaba nga baluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu mbeera eyo. Omwoyo Omutukuvu abalaga ekyo ekinaagulumiza Kitange era ekisinga obulungi gye bali n’eri abalala. Bwe kitaba bwe kityo bajja kufuna okuddibwamu ng’okwo omwana omubi kwe yafuna okuva eri gavana kitaawe gwe yali aweerezza n’obuzira bungi n’ekitiibwa. Omwana bwe yaleeta okusaba kwe mu linnya lya kitaawe n’asaba omulimu n’ekisa, gavana n’amulaga obulamu bwe obubi n’empisa ze, n’agamba nti, “Tonsaba mu linnya lya kitaawo, wabula sooka ogende okole ng’ekyokulabirako kye bwe kiri. Omuwendo gwe omunene guleme kubeera ku mimwa gyo gyokka, wabula gutwale mu bulamu bwo, olwo okusaba kwo kujja kukkirizibwa.”

8. Wakati w’okusaba kw’abo abansinza n’okuntendereza n’emimwa gyabwe gyokka n’okw’abo abakikola okuva mu mutima gwabwe waliwo enjawulo nnene nnyo. Ng’ekyokulabirako, omu eyali omusinza ow’amazima yasabiranga bulijjo omulala amaaso ge gazibuke akkirize amazima, ate omulala eyali omusinza mu linnya lyokka emirundi mingi yasabanga mu bulabe bwe eri omusinza wange ow’amazima aziba amaaso. Ku nkomerero okusaba kw’omusinza ow’amazima ne kuwulirwa olw’okwagala kwa Katonda, era oyo eyali edda munnanfuusi bunnanfuusi n’afuna okulaba okw’omwoyo. N’omutima gwe nga gujjudde essanyu omusajja ono n’afuuka omukkiriza ow’amazima, era ow’oluganda omwesigwa era ow’olubeerera ow’omuweereza wange ow’amazima.

9. Okusaba kusobozesa abantu ebintu bye bataasobole mu ngeri ndala, era balaba mu bulamu ebintu eby’ekitalo ebitali nti biwakanya bulungi amateeka n’endowooza ez’amagezi g’ensi, wabula ebitwalibwa ng’ebitasoboka n’akatono. Abantu ba ssaayansi tebategeera nti oyo eyateekateeka ebitonde byonna n’abikolera amateeka, tasobola kusibirwa mabega wa mitayimbwa gya mateeka ge ye. Amakubo g’Omuteesi w’Amateeka omukulu tegakeberebwa, kubanga by’ayagala n’ekigendererwa kye eky’olubeerera bwe mukisa n’okukulaakulana kw’ebitonde bye byonna, era ensonga lwaki omuntu obuntu tasobola kutegeera kino eri nti ebintu eby’omwoyo bikeberwa Mwoyo (1 Abakkolinso 2:14).

Ekyamagero ekisinga byonna obukulu kwe kuzaalibwa obuggya mu muntu, era eri omuntu ayise mu kyamagero kino, ebirala byonna bifuuka ebisoboka. Kaakano mu nsi ezinnyogovu ennyo olutindo olw’amazzi kintu kya bulijjo okulaba, kubanga ku ngulu w’omugga bwe gukwata ne gufuuka omuzira omukalubo, amazzi agali wansi geeyongera okukulukuta mu ddembe, naye abantu basomoka ku lutindo olw’omuzira mu bwangu era mu bukuumi. Naye singa omuntu yayogera ku lutindo olw’amazzi olusala omugga ogukulukuta eri abantu abatuuyana bulijjo olw’ebbugumu ery’omu nsi ezookya, amangu ddala bandigambye nti ekintu ng’ekyo tekisoboka era kiwakanya amateeka g’obutonde. Enjawulo y’emu ennene eri wakati w’abo abaazaalibwa obuggya era abakuuma obulamu bwabwe obw’omwoyo olw’okusaba, n’abo ababeera mu bulamu bw’ensi era abatwala ebintu ebirabika byokka nga bya muwendo, era bwe batyo nga tebamanyi n’akatono bulamu bwa mmeeme.

10. Oyo ayagala okufuna okuva eri Katonda olw’okusaba omukisa gw’obulamu obw’omwoyo, alina okukkiriza n’okugonda awatali kubuusabuusa. Omusajja eyajja gye ndi n’omukono ogwakala, bwe nnamulagira okugolola omukono gwe amangu ago n’agonda, era bw’atyo omukono gwe ne guwona ne guba ng’ogunnaagwo (Matayo 12:10-13). Naye kale singa mu kifo ky’okugonda amangu ago yatandika okuwakana n’agamba nti, “Nnyinza ntya okugolola omukono gwange? Singa nnali nsobola okukikola, lwaki nnandizze gy’oli? Sooka owonye omukono gwange, olwo nja kusobola okugugolola.” Ebyo byonna byandirabiddwa ng’ebirimu amagezi era ebituufu, naye omukono gwe teguwandiwonye n’akatono.

Oyo asaba alina okukkiriza n’okuba omuwulize, n’agolola gye ndi mu kusaba emikono gye eminafu era egyakala, olwo kiriba gye ndi okumuwa obulamu obw’omwoyo, era ng’obwetaavu bwe bwe buli bw’aliweebwa (Matayo 21:22).

fields.title: Okuweereza
fields.body_html:
Ekitundu I

Omuyigirizwa,—Mukama, okuweereza amakulu gaakwo aga ddala ge galuwa? Kwe kugamba tuweereza Omutonzi, oluvannyuma ne tuweereza ebitonde bye ku lulwe? Obuyambi bw’omuntu, ate nga mu butuufu kiwuka bukiwuka, bulina omugaso gwonna eri Katonda mu kulabirira amaka ge amanene, oba Katonda yeetaaga obuyambi bw’omuntu okukuuma oba okuwonya ekimu ku bitonde bye?

Mukama,—1. Okuweereza kwe kukola kw’obulamu obw’omwoyo, era kye kiweebwayo eky’obutonde ekireetebwa okwagala. Katonda, ali Okwagala, bulijjo akola mu kulabirira ebitonde bye, era by’ayagala biri nti ebitonde bye, n’okusingira ddala omuntu, gwe yabumba mu kifaananyi kye ne mu kufaanana kwe, tebabeeranga nga tebalina kye bakola. Mu kulabirira n’okukuuma ebitonde bye Katonda teyeetaaga buyambi bwa muntu yenna, kubanga yabitonda mu ngeri nti awatali buyambi bwe tebisobola kweyongera kubeerawo, era ye yennyini ye yateekawo byonna ebyetaagisa okumatiza okwegomba kwabyo. Mu kuweereza abalala okw’amazima mulimu omugaso guno omunene, nti kuyamba oyo aweereza—nga bwe kyakutuukako e Tibet. Bwe wali otidde okufa olw’obunnyogovu obw’amaanyi, n’olaba omuntu agalamidde ng’aziikiddwa mu muzira era ng’ali kumpi kufa, n’ogenda gy’ali n’omusitula ku bibegabega byo n’omutwala mu maaso, era okufuba kwe wakola ne kuleeta ebbugumu mu mubiri gwo, eryayingira ne mu gugwe, era ye naawe ne muwona mwembi, ne kiba nti mu kumuwonya wawonya obulamu bwo ggwe. Eno y’enkomerero ey’amazima ey’okuweereza. Tewali ayinza kubeera mulamu yekka nga talina buyambi bwa balala. Singa omuntu afuna obuyambi okuva eri omulala, n’atayagala kuzzaayo buyambi bw’asobola, omuntu oyo atasiima talina ddembe kusuubira buyambi bwonna okuva eri omuntu yenna.

2. Okutuusa omuntu lw’anaaleeta mu kuweereza Katonda n’abantu obusobozi n’amaanyi Katonda bye yamuwa, tajja kufuna okuva eri Katonda obuyambi ye yekka bw’asobola okugaba. Amangu ddala ng’omuntu akoze ekitundu kye, Katonda ajja kukimaliriza. Ng’ekyokulabirako, okuggyawo ejjinja ku ntaana ya Laazaalo gwali mulimu gwa muntu, era tekyali kyetaagisa Katonda kukozesa maanyi ge okukikola; naye abantu bwe baamala okuyiringisa ejjinja, olwo Katonda, kwe kugamba nze, n’akola ekyo ekyali kisukka amaanyi n’obukugu bw’omuntu, kubanga nnawa omufu obulamu. Ne oluvannyuma lw’ekyo waaliwo omulimu omuntu gwe yali alina okukola, okusumulula Laazaalo mu ngoye ez’okuziika alyoke abeere wa ddembe ddala (Yokaana 11:39, 41, 44).

Bwe kiri bwe kityo ku abo abafudde mu kibi. Gwe mulimu gw’abayigirizwa bange okuyiringisa amayinja ag’oku ntaana ag’ebiziyiza n’ebizibu, naye okuwa obulamu gwe mulimu gwange. Era emirundi mingi abamu abafunye obulamu obw’omwoyo basigala nga bakyali mu buddu bw’empisa zaabwe embi ez’edda n’enkolagana embi, era bwe buvunaanyizibwa bw’abaana bange okubatuusa mu ddembe erituukiridde; era okukola okuweereza kuno okunene basaanidde bulijjo okubeera abatunula mu mutima ne mu mmeeme.

3. Kabaka omu bwe yali ku kitanda ky’okufa n’agamba omuweereza we omwesigwa bw’ati: “Mbadde n’empisa, bwe mba nsimbula olugendo, okukutuma okunkulembera okundangirira n’okuteekateeka okwanirizibwa kwange. Ŋŋenda mu nsi y’abafu. Kale genda obategeeze nti nnaatera okubeegattako.” Mu kusooka omuweereza omwesimbu teyategeera mukama we kye yali ategeeza, naye amangu ddala nga alabye nti kye yali ategeeza kiri nti afe bw’atyo amukulembere mu nsi y’abafu, omusajja oyo omwesigwa, awatali kulwa wadde kubuusabuusa na kamu, n’afumita ekitala mu mutima gwe, bw’atyo n’ayingira mu nsi y’abafu, alindirire mukama we eyo. Bwe kityo bwe buvunaanyizibwa bw’abo abampeereza, nze Mukama w’Obulamu era Kabaka wa bakabaka (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 3:15; Okubikkulirwa 19:16), okutwala enjiri ey’obulokozi eri abo abafudde mu kibi, n’okuba abeetegefu wadde okuwaayo obulamu bwabwe ku lwange, nze eyajja ku nsi olw’obulokozi bwabwe era eryongera okujja omulundi omulala (Okubikkulirwa 2:10).

4. Omwana omujeemu lumu yava mu nnyumba ya kitaawe ne yeegatta ku kibinja ky’abanyazi, era ne bwe waayita ebbanga n’afuuka omuzira era atalina kisa nga bannaabwe. Kitaawe n’ayita abaweereza be n’abalagira okugenda eri mutabani we bamugambe nti bw’anaayenenya n’akomawo awaka, byonna bijja kusonyiyibwa, era ajja kumwaniriza mu nnyumba ye. Naye abaweereza, nga batya ensi ey’omu nsiko n’abanyazi abakambwe, ne bagaana okugenda. Awo mukulu w’omuvubuka, eyamwagala nga kitaabwe bwe yamwagala, n’asimbula okutwala obubaka obw’okusonyiyibwa. Naye nga yaakayingira mu kibira, ekibinja ky’abanyazi ne kimulumba ne kimufumita ebiwundu eby’okufa. Muto we yali omu ku kibinja ekyo, era bwe yategeera mukulu we n’ajjula ennaku n’okwejjusa. Mukulu we n’asobola okutuusa obubaka obw’okusonyiyibwa, oluvannyuma, ng’agamba nti ekigendererwa ky’obulamu bwe kituukiriziddwa era nti omulimu gw’okwagala gukoleddwa, n’awaayo omwoyo gwe. Ssaddaaka eno eya mukulu we n’ekwata nnyo ku muvubuka omujeemu, n’addayo eri kitaawe ng’ayenenya, era okuva ku lunaku olwo n’atandika obulamu obuggya. Kale tekisaanidde abaana bange okuba abeetegefu okuwaayo obulamu bwabwe balyoke batuuse obubaka obw’okusaasira eri ab’oluganda lwabwe abaakyama era abaazikirira mu kibi, nga nange bwe nnawaayo obulamu bwange olw’obulokozi bwa bonna?

5. Abaana bange bali ng’omunnyo mu nsi (Matayo 5:13). Obuweke bw’omunnyo bwe butasaanuuka tebusobola kuwa buka bwabwo. Bwe kiri n’abaana bange. Bwe batasaanuusibwa mu muliro gw’okwagala n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ne bafuulibwa ssaddaaka ennamu, tebajja kusobola kutuusa ku mmeeme yonna n’emu obulamu obwo obw’omwoyo era obw’omu ggulu mwe yandirokokedde. Tebajja kusinga mukazi wa Lutti eyafuuka empagi ey’omunnyo (Olubereberye 19:26). Naye nga ku lwammwe bwe nnasaanuuka mu Gesusemane (Lukka 22:44), ne ku musaalaba ne mpaayo obulamu bwange ndyoke ndokole obulamu bw’abantu, kubanga obulamu bulina okusasulirwa n’obulamu, bwe mutyo nammwe muyitibwa okuwaayo obulamu bwammwe, bwe mutyo mutuuse obuka bw’obulamu obw’omwoyo eri abalala n’okubawonya okufa.

6. Omutemu omu, mu kifo ky’okuwanikibwa, yasindikibwa mu lutalo, era eyo n’alwanirira kabaka we n’ensi ye n’obuzira obutaggwaamu maanyi, ne kiba nti newaakubadde nga yalumizibwa nnyo, n’akomawo ng’awangudde. Oluvannyuma lw’okuwangula n’aleetebwa nate mu mbuga okusalirwa omusango. Kabaka, bwe yalaba ku mubiri gwe enkovu z’ebiwundu bye, n’asazaamu omusango gw’okufa, era teyakoma ku kumusonyiwa musango gwe, wabula n’amuwa n’empeera ennene n’amusitula mu kifo eky’ekitiibwa. Bwe batyo abo abali ku ludda lwange abalwana mu Lutalo Olutukuvu ne Setaani n’obuzira n’obuvumu balyoke balokole ab’oluganda lwabwe, basajja na bakazi, tebalifuna kusonyiyibwa bibi byabwe kwokka okuva gye ndi, wabula mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda ndibawa engule n’obwakabaka (Yakobo 5:20; Okubikkulirwa 3:21).

7. Ng’omudumu ogukozesebwa okutambuza amazzi amayonjo bwe gukuumibwa nga mulongoofu olw’amazzi agaguyitamu, bwe batyo abo abatwala Amazzi ag’Obulamu eri abalala nga bayita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, bo bennyini balongoosebwa ne bafuuka abasika b’obwakabaka bwa Katonda.

8. Engeri esinga obulungi omukkiriza gy’ayinza okutegekebwamu okufuna Omwoyo Omutukuvu n’okuweereza, kwe kugondera eddoboozi ery’omu ggulu era amangu ago, nga bw’asobola, n’atandika okuweereza. Ng’okufuuka omuwuzi omulungi bwe kitaliiko mugaso kuyigirizibwa okuggyako ng’omuntu ayingidde mu mazzi n’atandika okuwuga ku bubwe, era ng’omuntu ayinza okufuuka omukugu mu kuwuga kwokka olw’okwegezangamu bulijjo, okusooka mu mazzi amampi n’oluvannyuma mu mawanvu, bwe kityo, okuyiga engeri y’okulokola emmeeme z’abo ababbira mu mazzi ag’ekizikiza ag’ekibi, engeri esinga obulungi kwe kuyingira mu ssomero erimu lyokka ery’amazima era ery’omugaso ery’eby’obwakatonda, kwe kwegatta nange (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 4:13).

9. Waliwo abamu abaziyizibwa okuweereza olw’okulowooza nti tebalina busobozi, ne batajjukira nti amaanyi gange gawa obuyinza mu bunafu (2 Abakkolinso 12:9). Bafaanana abalwadde, newaakubadde nga bawonye obulwadde bwabwe era nga balya emmere ezimba omubiri, naye ne basigala nga banafu kubanga tebakola mulimu gwonna so tebeegezaamu bulungi. Abakkiriza ab’engeri eyo kye beetaaga kwe kunneesiga ne basimbula okulokola aboonoonyi baleme kuzikirira.

Ekitundu II

1. Okwagala lye jjinja erikebera amazima mwe gategeererwa nti ga ddala, era kwe bantu bonna kwe banaategeereranga nti muli bayigirizwa bange (Yokaana 13:35). Era nkozesa n’ekitala eky’obwenkanya, ne kiba nti mu kulaba okusooka abamu bayinza okulowooza nti, nga Sulemaani, ngenderera okumaliriza omulimu gwange awatali kusaasira (1 Bassekabaka 3:16-28), naye ekigendererwa kyange, nga bwe kyali ekikye, kwe kukozesa ejjinja erikebera ery’okwagala eriggyayo amazima, ne liraga nti muli baana ba Katonda oyo ow’Okwagala eyawaayo obulamu bwe okulokola obwammwe. N’olwekyo musaanidde okubeera mu kwagala okwo ne muweerezagana, era wadde okuwaayo obulamu bwammwe okuweereza abalala, nga nange bwe nnawaayo obulamu bwange ku lwammwe. Olwo nga nze bwe ndi omulamu, nammwe muliba balamu (Yokaana 14:19).

2. Bwe muba nga muli bayigirizwa bange ddala, okuweereza kwammwe okw’okwagala kujja kubala ebibala bingi (Yokaana 15:8). Era abantu bwe babavuma ne babakasukira ebivume, mubasabire, era mu kifo ky’okubavuma mubaleke baloze ebibala ebiwoomu eby’okwagala kwammwe.

Abalenzi ab’ettima, bwe balaba ebibala ebiwoomu ku muti, bagukasukira amayinja, n’omuti awatali kwemulugunya ne gubagwira, mu kifo ky’amayinja, ebibala byagwo ebirungi. Kubanga omuti tegulina mayinja gwa kukasuka, wabula Katonda ky’agwadde, kye gugaba awatali kwemulugunya. Temuterebuka olw’okuyisibwa obubi, kubanga ekyo abantu okubavuma kikakasa ddala nti obulamu bwammwe bubala ebibala. Newaakubadde nga babayisa bwe batyo olw’obuggya n’ettima, naye mu ngeri eyo ekitiibwa kya Kitammwe ow’omu ggulu kyolesebwa. Temulowooza nti Katonda alumwa enjala y’ekitiibwa, oba nti waliwo ekibulamu mu kitiibwa kye omuntu ky’ayinza okujjuzaamu. Nedda n’akatono! Ekigendererwa ky’okwagala kwe kwe kusitula ekitonde ekyo ekinafu, omuntu, okuva mu mbeera ey’ekibi mwe yagwa n’amusitula okutuuka mu ggulu lye ery’ekitiibwa. Bw’atyo tewa kitiibwa ye yennyini wabula akiwa omuntu ng’amulongoosa era ng’amutukuza, era mu kino eky’amagero n’obukulu bw’okwagala kwe birabisibwa.

3. Abo abaleetedde bangi olw’okufuba kwabwe okukyuka okuva mu kibi ne bafuna obutuukirivu mu nze, ndibawa ekitiibwa kinene bwe kityo nti okusooka balyakaayakana ng’emmunyeenye, oluvannyuma bwe balifuulibwa abatuukiridde balyakaayakana ng’enjuba mu bwakabaka bwa Kitaabwe. Emmunyeenye ziggwaamu ekitangaala ne zibula Enjuba ey’Obutuukirivu bw’evaayo, naye Kitange ky’ayagala kiri nti abaana be bafuulibwe abatuukiridde nga ye era bayakaayakane naye mu kitiibwa eky’olubeerera, nga basanyukira emirembe gyonna mu kwagala kwe okutaliiko kkomo era okw’olubeerera.

4. Waliwo ebitonde ebitono ennyo ebiri wansi nnyo w’omuntu, ng’akawuka akaaka ekiro n’ekitangaala kyako ekimyansamyansa, n’ebimera ebimu ebitono mu bimera eby’omu nsozi za Himalaya, ebyakira nga bwe bisobola ekibira eky’ekizikiza mwe bibeera n’ekitangaala kyabyo ekinafu. Era n’ebyennyanja ebitonotono ebiwuga mu mazzi amawanvu ag’ennyanja bifulumya ekitangaala ekimyansamyansa ekiluŋŋamya ebyennyanja ebirala ne kibiyamba okuwona abalabe baabyo. Kale abaana bange balina okusingawo ennyo okuba omusana mu nsi (Matayo 5:14) n’okunyiikira mu kwefiiriza okuleeta mu kkubo ery’amazima, nga bakozesa omusana gwabwe Katonda gwe yabawa, abo abali mu bulabe bw’okufuuka omuyiggo gwa Setaani olw’ekizikiza.

5. Bwe batakozesa maanyi gano agaava mu ggulu mu kuweereza Katonda n’ebitonde bye, bali mu bulabe bw’okufiirwa emirembe gyonna ebirabo ebyo eby’omu ggulu. Kino kye kyatuuka ku byennyanja ebimu ebibeera mu mazzi amawanvu ag’empuku ez’ekizikiza, era ne ku bamu ku bannaddiini ababeera bokka e Tibet, kubanga byombi bimaze ebbanga ddene nnyo mu kizikiza ne bifiirwa ddala okulaba kwabyo. Mu ngeri y’emu n’ekinyonyi ekinene ekiyitibwa maaya, olw’obutakozesa biwaawaatiro byakyo, kifiiriddwa ddala obusobozi bw’okubuuka. N’olwekyo mwegendereze obutalagajjalira birabo oba ttalanta zonna ze mwateresebwa, wabula muzikozese mulyoke mugabane ku ssanyu n’ekitiibwa bya Mukama wammwe (Matayo 25:14-30).

6. Oluusi bwe wabaawo omulimu omunene ogw’okuweereza ogulina okukolebwa, ogunaaleetera bangi obulokozi n’omukisa, ndonda olw’ekigendererwa kyange abo abatwalibwa nga ba wansi mu maaso g’ensi, kubanga tebeenyumiriza mu maanyi gaabwe wadde mu magezi gaabwe, wabula nga banneesiga ddala, era nga obusobozi obutono bwe balina babutwala nga si bwa muwendo nnyo, bawaayo byonna bye balina ne bye bali eri omulimu gwange ku lw’abantu (1 Abakkolinso 1:26-30). Ng’ekyokulabirako, bwe nnaliisa mu ddungu abasajja enkumi ttaano n’emigaati etaano n’ebyennyanja bibiri, ojja kujjukira nti ekyamagero kino saakikola nga mpita mu bayigirizwa bange, kubanga baali bajjudde okubuusabuusa n’okusoberwa era baali baagala okusiibula ekibiina nga kirumwa enjala (Yokaana 6:9). Omuweereza wange ku mulundi ogwo yali mulenzi muto gwe nnali mmaze okuwonya okusannyalala. Ng’ajjudde okwegomba okuwulira ebigambo byange, n’amalirira okungoberera. Nnyina omwavu n’amusibira mu ngoye ze emigaati egya sayiri n’ebyennyanja ebikalu, ebimala olugendo lwa nnaku bbiri oba ssatu, bwe kityo bwe waabaawo okubuuza emmere y’ekibiina, omulenzi oyo omwesigwa amangu ddala n’aleeta byonna bye yalina n’abiteeka ku bigere by’abayigirizwa. Newaakubadde nga waaliyo abagagga abaali n’emmere esinga obulungi, ng’emigaati egy’eŋŋaano, tebaali beetegefu kugiwaayo; bwe kityo okuva mu migaati egya sayiri egy’omulenzi ono, eyalina erinnya lyange, olw’omukisa gwange ekibiina ne kiriisibwa emmere esinga obulungi.

7. Waliwo bangi abatalina kwebaza bwe batyo nti emikisa gyonna gye baweebwa, ne bwe kituuka ku byamagero okukolebwa ku lw’obulungi bwabwe, basigala nga tebamatidde era nga tebeebaza. Abantu ng’abo tebayinza kukozesebwa mu kuweereza abalala n’okubaleetera omukisa, wabula bafaanana omusajja gwe nnawonya oluvannyuma lw’okubonaabona okumala emyaka amakumi asatu mu munaana n’obulwadde obutawonyezeka, kubanga mu kifo ky’okwebaza n’okunzikiriza, teyafaayo na kujjukira linnya lyange (Yokaana 5:12-13). Okuva ku bantu ng’abo ensi teyinza kusuubira mukisa gwonna; guva eri abo bokka abali nga nnamwandu omwavu, abeetegefu okuwaayo byonna bye balina, wadde byonna bye bandiriddeko (Lukka 21:2-4).

8. Olw’okuweereza okw’amazima n’okutuukiriza omulimu, abaweereza bange balina okuba abeetegefu okuwaayo n’obulamu bwennyini—ng’omuserikale oyo omwesigwa eyasigala mu kifo kye mu bunnyogovu obw’amaanyi n’omuzira nga gugwa okutuusa lwe yakwatibwa empewo n’afa, era ng’ekifaananyi ekyole n’asigala mu kifo kye, newaakubadde ng’abalala ab’omu bakuumi baagenda okwota omuliro. Kabaka bwe yajja n’amulaba ng’ayimiridde nga munywevu era mwesigwa ne mu kufa, n’aggyako engule ye n’agiteeka akaseera ku mutwe gwe, ng’agamba nti: “Omuserikale n’omuweereza omwesigwa bw’atyo asaanidde ekitiibwa n’ekitiibwa ky’engule yange. Singa yali mulamu, kubanga nandimufudde omukulu w’obwakabaka bwange!” Bwe batyo bwe balina okuba abaweereza bange abeesigwa mu kuweereza kwe nnabalondera, era abo abamaliriza omulimu gwabwe n’okukkiriza n’obuvumu ng’obwo ndibawa engule etaggwaawo ey’obwakabaka obw’olubeerera (2 Timoseewo 4:4, 5-8).

9. Waliwo bangi abaayonoona ebiseera eby’omuwendo bye baaweebwa okumpeereza, naye ne kaakano bakyalina omukisa okwezuukusa n’okukozesa obulungi ennyo ebiseera ebibasigaddeyo. Bafaanana omuyizzi, bwe yali atambulatambula mu kibira, n’alondawo amayinja amalungi ku lubalama lw’omugga. Nga tamanyi muwendo gwago, n’agakozesa limu ku limu mu nvuumuulo ye okukuba ebinyonyi ebyali bitudde ku miti egyali okumpi n’omugga, era bwe gatyo limu ku limu ne gagwa mu mazzi ne gabula. Ng’akyalina erimu mu ngalo ze n’addayo mu kibuga, era bwe yali ayita mu katale omuweesi w’amayinja ag’omuwendo n’alirabako, n’agamba omusajja oyo omusirusiru nti lyali jjinja lya alimaasi ery’omuwendo omungi lye yandifunyeeko enkumi n’enkumi za rupiya. Bwe yawulira ebyo n’atandika okwekungubagira ng’agamba nti, “Zinsanze! Saamanya muwendo gwago, era mbadde nkozesa alimaasi zino nnyingi okukuba ebinyonyi ku lubalama lw’omugga, ne zigwa mu mugga ne zibula, bwe kitandibadde bwe kityo nandibadde nnaggagga ow’obukadde. Naye ejjinja lino ndiwonyezza, era ekyo kyakufuna kyennyini.” Buli lunaku luli ng’alimaasi ey’omuwendo, era newaakubadde ng’ennaku nnyingi ez’omuwendo ogutabalika zaayonoonebwa mu kunoonya amasanyu agayita amangu, era ne zibbira emirembe gyonna mu buziba bw’ebyayita, musaanidde okuzuukuka mulabe omuwendo gw’ezo ezisigaddeyo, era nga muzikozesa mu ngeri esinga obulungi mwekuŋŋaanyize obugagga obw’omwoyo. Muzikozese mu kumpeereza, nze eyabawa obulamu n’emikisa gyabwo gyonna egy’omuwendo ogutabalika, era nga mugikozesa okulokola abalala okuva mu kibi n’okufa mujja kufuna empeera ey’olubeerera era ey’omu ggulu.

fields.title: Omusaalaba n’Ekyama ky’Okubonaabona
fields.body_html:
Ekitundu I

Omuyigirizwa,—Omusaalaba gulina makulu ki era kigendererwa ki, era lwaki obulumi n’okubonaabona biriwo mu nsi?

Mukama,—1. Omusaalaba kye kisumuluzo ky’eggulu. Mu kaseera ke nnatwala omusaalaba ku bibegabega byange olw’okubatizibwa kwange ku lw’aboonoonyi, eggulu lyaggulwawo, era olw’okwetikka omusaalaba okumala emyaka amakumi asatu mu esatu n’olw’okufiira ku gwo, eggulu, eryali liggaddwawo eri abakkiriza olw’ekibi, lyabaggulirwawo emirembe gyonna.

Kaakano amangu ddala ng’abakkiriza basitudde omusaalaba gwabwe ne bangoberera, bayingira mu ggulu nga bayita mu nze (Yokaana 10:9) ne batandika okunyumirwa essanyu eryo eritaliiko kkomo ensi ly’etayinza kutegeera, kubanga eggulu liggaddwawo eri obutakkiriza. Essuubi n’ebyo by’ayitamu bijja kuyigiriza atakkiriza nti essanyu liddirira obulumi, naye nti essanyu eryo teriwangaala. Naye nze mpa abaana bange emirembe mu bulumi, n’essanyu erituukiridde n’emirembe. Abo abasitula omusaalaba gwange n’essanyu bo bennyini gubasitula, era bwe bawaniriddwa omusaalaba ogwo bulijjo, ku nkomerero bayingira mu ggulu.

2. Obulumi buva mu butonde bw’omuntu obukyamu era obujeemu, ng’ebbugumu ery’omu nsi ezookya bwe likooya era bwe liruma abo ababeera mu nsi ezinnyogovu, n’obunnyogovu obw’amaanyi bwe buruma abo ababeera mu nsi ezookya. Ebbugumu n’obunnyogovu byesigama ku nkolagana y’ensi n’enjuba. Bw’atyo omuntu, ng’akozesa eddembe lye ery’okwesalirawo, ayingira mu mbeera ey’okukkiriziganya oba ey’obutakkiriziganya ne Katonda, era kubanga amateeka ga Katonda gagendererwa obulamu obulungi obw’omwoyo n’essanyu ly’omuntu, okugawakanya kuleeta obulumi n’okubonaabona okw’omwoyo. Kaakano Katonda, mu kifo ky’okuggirawo ddala embeera zino ez’okuwakanya n’okujeemera by’ayagala, azikozesa okutegeeza omuntu lwatu nti ensi eno teyatondebwa kuba maka ge, wabula gy’ali nsi ya bugwira (2 Abakkolinso 5:1-2, 6).

Ensi eno eri kumutegekera bwetegesi maka matuukirivu era ag’olubeerera, era okukubwa kw’emitawaana okuddiŋŋana kugendererwa okukuuma omwoyo gwe nga gutunula, aleme kufuuka mulagajjavu, n’okuva ku mazima n’agabana ku kuzikirira kw’ensi eno etali nywevu. Agendererwa okuyingira mu kussa ekimu n’Omutonzi we, era bw’amala okusumululwa okuva mu kubonaabona n’ennaku ez’obulamu buno obuyita amangu, ayingire mu ggulu lye ery’essanyu n’emirembe eby’olubeerera.

3. Obulumi n’okubonaabona bikaawa ng’obutwa, naye era kimanyiddwa bulungi nti oluusi eddagala eriwonya obutwa lyennyini liba butwa. Bwe ntyo oluusi nkozesa obulumi n’okubonaabona ng’eddagala erikaawa okwongera obulamu obulungi obw’omwoyo n’amaanyi g’abakkiriza bange. Amangu ddala ng’obulamu bwabwe obutuukiridde bunywezeddwa, okubonaabona kwonna kujja kukoma. Obulumi bwabwe tebunsanyusa, kubanga ekigendererwa kyange kimu kyokka bwe bulungi bwabwe obw’olubeerera (Okukungubaga 3:31, 33).

4. Ng’oluvannyuma lwa musisi oluusi bwe muvaayo ensulo z’amazzi amawoomu mu bifo eby’eddungu, ne mu bifo ebikalu ne mufukirirwa ne mubala ebibala, bwe kityo mu mbeera ezimu okukankanyizibwa kw’okubonaabona kuggulawo munda mu mutima gw’omuntu ensulo ezikwekeddwa ez’amazzi amalamu, era mu kifo ky’okwemulugunya n’okwekubira enduulu mu ye muvaamu emigga egy’okwebaza n’essanyu (Zabbuli 119:67, 71).

5. Amangu ddala ng’omwana azaaliddwa mu nsi kyetaagisa nnyo atandike okukaaba n’okuleekaana, omukka gwe gutambule mu ddembe n’amawuggwe ge gatandike okukola mu bujjuvu; era bw’atakaaba olw’ensonga yonna, alina okukubibwako olupi okutuusa lw’akaaba. Bwe kiri n’okwagala okutuukiridde. Oluusi ndeetera abaana bange okukaaba olw’okukubwa n’okubalagala kw’obulumi n’okubonaabona, omukka gw’okusaba gutambule mu ddembe mu mawuggwe g’omwoyo gwabwe, bwe batyo bafune amaanyi amaggya babeere mu bulamu obutaggwaawo.

6. Omusaalaba gufaanana ekibala ekiyitibwa walnut, ekikuta kyakyo eky’ebweru kikaawa, naye omunda waakyo muwoomu era guzzaamu amaanyi. Bwe kityo omusaalaba tegulina bulungi bwonna obusikiriza mu ndabika yaagwo ey’okungulu, naye eri asitula omusaalaba engeri yaagwo entuufu emubikkulirwa, n’asanga mu gwo ebisinga obuwoomi eby’emirembe egy’omwoyo.

7. Bwe nnafuuka omuntu, nnasitula omusaalaba omukambwe olw’obulokozi bw’omuntu, si okumala essaawa omukaaga zokka ez’okukomererwa kwange, wadde emyaka esatu n’ekitundu egy’obuweereza bwange, wabula okumala emyaka gyonna amakumi asatu mu esatu n’ekitundu egy’obulamu bwange, omuntu alyoke awonyezebwe obukaawu bw’okufa. Nga bwe kiruma omuntu omuyonjo okumala ne bwe kiba eddakiika ntono mu kifo ekirimu obucaafu n’ekko, bwe batyo abo ababeera mu nze bakiraba nga kinyinyaza nnyo okubeera mu bantu ababi; era eno y’ensonga lwaki abantu abamu abasaba, nga banyiikadde olw’obucaafu bw’ekibi, baaleka ensi ne bagenda okubeera bokka mu ddungu ne mu mpuku. Kale lowooza ku kino: abantu nga bo bennyini baali boonoonyi bwe bawulira okubeerawo kw’ekibi nga kuzibu nnyo okugumiikiriza ne batasobola kubeera wamu na bantu banaabwe, n’okubaleka ne babaleka, ne batayagala kuddayo gye bali nate, kale ogugwange omusaalaba gwali gwa bulumi era muzito kyenkana ki, nze, Ensulo y’Obutukuvu, okuba nga nnalina okubeera okumala emyaka egisukka amakumi asatu mu esatu bulijjo wakati mu bantu abaayonoonebwa ekibi. Okutegeera kino n’okukisiima nga bwe kisaanidde kisukka amaanyi g’amagezi g’omuntu, era ne bamalayika bayaayaanira okukyetegereza (1 Peetero 1:12). Kubanga nga tewannabaawo kutonda baali bamanyi nti Katonda kwagala, naye gye bali kyali kintu kya kitalo nnyo era ekyewuunyisa ennyo nti okwagala kwa Katonda kwenkana awo, nti okulokola ebitonde bye n’okubireetera obulamu obutaggwaawo, afuuke omuntu era asitule omusaalaba omukambwe.

8. Mu bulamu buno nange ngabana ku musaalaba gw’abo ababeera mu nze, era nnyingira mu kubonaabona kwabwe (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 9:4). Newaakubadde nga bo bitonde nange ndi Mutonzi waabwe, naye, ng’omubiri n’omwoyo, newaakubadde nga bintu bibiri ebyawukana, bwe bitabuddwa wamu nnyo nti singa n’ekitundu ky’omubiri ekisingayo obutono kiwulira obulumi omwoyo amangu ago gukimanya; bwe ntyo nze ndi bulamu era mwoyo gw’abaana bange, nabo bali, nga bwe kyandibadde, omubiri gwange n’ebitundu byange. Ngabana ku bulumi bwabwe bwonna n’ennaku yaabwe yonna, era mu kiseera ekituufu mbawummuza.

9. Nga nze kennyini bwe nnasitula omusaalaba, nsobola okuwonya n’okukuuma mu bukuumi obutuukiridde abo abasitula omusaalaba, ne bwe baba nga batambulira wakati mu miliro gy’okuyigganyizibwa. Nnali n’abavubuka abasatu mu kikoomi kya Nebukadduneeza, ekyali kitasobola kubakola kabi newaakubadde nga kyali kyaka n’amaanyi gaakyo gonna (Danyeri 3:23-25; 1 Peetero 4:12-13). Bwe batyo abo abafunye obulamu obuggya olw’okubatizibwa kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu tebalibaako bwe bawulira miliro gya kuyigganyizibwa wadde ekintu kyonna ekirumya, kubanga bulijjo babeera mu nze mu mirembe ne mu bukuumi eby’olubeerera.

Ekitundu II

1. Mu bunnyogovu obw’amaanyi obw’ekiseera eky’obutiti emiti giyimirira nga tegirina bikoola, era kirabika ng’obulamu bwagyo nabwo bugenze emirembe gyonna, naye mu kiseera ky’ettoggo gissaako ebikoola ebiggya n’ebimuli ebirungi, n’ebibala ne bitandika okulabika. Bwe kyali bwe kityo gye ndi mu kukomererwa kwange ne mu kuzuukira kwange, era bwe kiri bwe kityo eri abasitula omusaalaba gwange abeesigwa (2 Abakkolinso 4:8-11; 6:4-10). Newaakubadde nga balabika ng’abamenyeddwa era abafudde wansi w’omusaalaba gwabwe, bakyassaako ebimuli ebirungi n’ebibala eby’ekitiibwa eby’obulamu obutaggwaawo ebibeerawo emirembe gyonna.

2. Mu kusimba omuti omuwoomu ku mukaawa, byombi biwulira akambe era byombi biyitibwa okubonaabona omuti omukaawa gulyoke gubale ebibala ebiwoomu. Bwe kityo, okuyingiza mu butonde obubi obw’omuntu, obwaweebwa obutwa bw’ekibi, obulamu obw’omwoyo era obutukuvu, kyali kyetaagisa okusooka nze kennyini, oluvannyuma n’abakkiriza, okubonaabona obulumi obungi obw’omusaalaba, balyoke mu biseera ebigenda okujja babalenga ebibala ebirungi emirembe gyonna, era bw’atyo okwagala kwa Katonda okw’ekitiibwa kulabisibwe.

3. Singa mu nsi muno abantu babayigganya ne babawaayiriza, temukkiriza kino kubeewuunyisa wadde okubanakuwaza, kubanga kino si kifo kya kuwummuliramu gye muli, wabula kisaawe kya lutalo. Zibasanze abantu b’ensi bwe babawaana (Lukka 6:26), kubanga kino kikakasa nti mutwaliddwa empisa zaabwe enkyamu n’engeri zaabwe. Kiwakanya obutonde bwabwe bwennyini n’embeera yaabwe okuwaana abaana bange, kubanga omusana n’ekizikiza tebisobola kubeera wamu. Singa olw’okwolesa obwolesa abantu ababi bakola ebikontana n’obutonde bwabwe ne balekera awo okubayigganya, okufiirwa kwammwe kwe kusinga obunene, kubanga obuyinza bwabwe buyingira mu bulamu bwammwe obw’omwoyo, n’okukula kwammwe okw’omwoyo ne kuziyizibwa.

Ate era, okwesiga ensi oba abantu b’ensi kwe kuzimba ennyumba yo ku musenyu, kubanga leero bajja kukusitula waggulu ate enkya bakusuule wansi nnyo nga tewakyasigadde kabonero konna ku ggwe, kubanga mu byonna tebanywevu. Bwe nnayambuka e Yerusaalemi ku Mbaga ey’Okuyitako, bonna n’eddoboozi limu ne batandika okuleekaana nti, “Ozaana! Ozaana!” (Matayo 21:9), era nga wayise ennaku ssatu zokka, bwe baalaba nti bye njogera biwakanya obulamu bwabwe obw’ekibi n’obw’okwenoonyeza, amangu ago ne bakyuka ne batandika okuleekaana nti, “Mukomerere ku musaalaba! Mukomerere ku musaalaba!” (Lukka 23:21).

4. Singa olw’obutategeeragana obumu abakkiriza abamu, oba bonna, bakukyukira ne bakuleetera obulumi, tolina kukitwala ng’omukisa omubi, kubanga bw’oneeyongera okutuukiriza omulimu gwo mu bwesimbu bwonna n’obwesigwa ng’oluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, jjukira nti Katonda yennyini n’eggye lyonna ery’omu ggulu bali ku ludda lwo.

Tokkiriza kuggwaamu maanyi, kubanga ekiseera kinaatera okutuuka ebigendererwa byo byonna ebirungi n’okuteesa kwo n’okwagala kwo kwonna okutaliimu kwefaako lwe biritegeezebwa ensi yonna, era mu maaso ga bonna, oliweebwa ekitiibwa olw’okufuba kwo n’okuweereza kwo okw’obwesigwa.

Nange, olw’obulokozi bw’abantu, nnalina okuleka byonna, era nze kennyini ne ndekebwa bonna, naye ku nkomerero ne nzirira byonna n’ebintu byonna. So teweewuunya ensi bw’ekuleka, kubanga yaleka Katonda yennyini, n’olwekyo mu kino olabika ng’omwana ow’amazima owa Kitaawo.

5. Tolowooza nti abo ababeera mu bugagga obw’okwejalabya era abalabika ng’abawangula bulijjo mu bya nsi bonna basinza Katonda ab’amazima, kubanga emirundi mingi kiba kikontana n’ekyo. Kisoboka endiga okubula ne ziva mu kisibo ne ku musumba, ne zisanga mu nsiko omuddo omulungi, naye ebbanga lyonna ziba mu bulabe bw’okutaagulwataagulwa ensolo enkambwe, era ekyo ddala kye kiriba ekibatuukako ku nkomerero. Naye ezo ezibeera mu kisibo n’omusumba, newaakubadde nga ziyinza okulabika ng’endwadde era ennafu, ddala tezirina bulabe era ziri mu kulabirira kw’omusumba. Eno y’enjawulo wakati w’abakkiriza n’abatakkiriza.

6. Obulamu bw’omukkiriza n’obw’atakkiriza bufaanagana nnyo ku ntandikwa yaabwo, naye enkomerero yaabwo bw’etuuka, byawukana ng’omusota n’ennyo ekola obuwuzi bwa silika. Omusota, ne bwe guyambula olususu lwagwo emirundi emeka, gusigala musota so si kirala, naye ennyo ya silika, bw’eyambula ekisu kyayo ekitali kirungi, efuuka ekitonde ekiggya, era ng’ekiwojjolo ekirungi ekinekaaneka ebuuka mu bbanga. Bw’atyo omukkiriza, bw’ayambula omubiri guno, ayingira mu mbeera ey’ekitiibwa eky’omwoyo n’abuuka emirembe gyonna mu ggulu, so ng’omwonoonyi oluvannyuma lw’okufa asigala mwonoonyi bwonoonyi.

Newaakubadde ng’ennyo ya silika, ng’efunze mu kisu, eri mu mbeera ey’okunyigirizibwa n’okulwana ng’eri ku musaalaba, naye embeera eyo yennyini ey’okulwana n’obuzibu ewa ebiwaawaatiro byayo amaanyi, n’egitegekera obulamu obugenda okujja. Bwe batyo abaana bange, nga bakyali mu mubiri, bali mu mbeera ey’okulwana n’okukaayana okw’omwoyo, era balindirira okusumululwa kwabwe nga basinda era nga beegomba, naye olw’okusitula omusaalaba mbawa amaanyi, ne bafuuka abategekeddwa ddala era abasaanidde embeera eyo ey’obulamu obutaggwaawo (Abaruumi 8:23).

Wakati mu lutalo luno olw’omwoyo, era ne bwe baba nga basitudde omusaalaba gwabwe, mbawa emirembe gy’omutima egy’ekitalo ddala, obuvumu bwabwe bulemenga kuggwaawo. Ng’ekyokulabirako, omujulizi wange omwesigwa bwe yamala okunjulira mu kigambo ne mu bikolwa, abalabe be ne bamukwata ne bamuwanika ku muti ng’omutwe gwe gudda wansi. Mu mbeera eyo emirembe gy’ebirowoozo bye gyali mingi nnyo ne kiba nti teyawulira n’akatono bulumi n’obuswavu bwe baali bamuleetedde, era n’akyukira abaali bamuyigganya n’agamba nti, “Engeri gye munkozesezzaamu tennakuwaza wadde okuntiisa, kubanga sisobola kusuubira kirala mu nsi buli kintu mw’ekiri ekivuunikiddwa, era omuntu mw’atayinza kulaba kintu kigolokofu. Okusinziira ku butonde bwammwe mmwe munvuunise nga bwe mulowooza, naye mu butuufu nnyimiridde bulungi. Nga bwe kiri ekifaananyi bwe kiteekebwa mu ttaala erisuula ebifaananyi ku kisenge nga kivuunikiddwa, kiraga ekifaananyi bulungi, bwe ntyo newaakubadde nga kaakano mu maaso g’ensi ndi mu kuvuunikibwa, nnyimiridde bulungi emirembe gyonna mu maaso ga Katonda n’ensi ey’omu ggulu, era mmutendereza olw’omusaalaba guno ogw’ekitiibwa.”

8. Eri abakkiriza oluusi kyandibadde kyangu okufuuka abajulizi abafiirira Erinnya lyange, naye era nneetaaga abajulirwa abalamu abanaawangayo bo bennyini buli lunaku nga ssaddaaka ennamu olw’obulokozi bw’abalala (1 Abakkolinso 15:31). Kubanga okufa kwangu, naye okubeera omulamu kye kizibu, kubanga obulamu bw’omukkiriza kwe kufa buli lunaku. Naye abo abeetegefu bwe batyo okuwaayo obulamu bwabwe ku lwange baligabana ku kitiibwa kyange era balibeera nange emirembe gyonna mu ssanyu erijjuvu.

9. Singa obulumi n’okubonaabona, ennaku n’okunakuwala, birinnya ng’ebire ne bibikka okumala akaseera Enjuba ey’Obutuukirivu ne bigikweka amaaso go, totya, kubanga ku nkomerero ekire kino eky’ennaku kirikka ku mutwe gwo ng’enkuba ey’omukisa, era Enjuba ey’Obutuukirivu erikwakira, n’etaddayo kugwa emirembe gyonna (Yokaana 16:20-22).

fields.title: Eggulu ne Ggeyeena
fields.body_html:
Ekitundu I

Omuyigirizwa,—Mukama, eggulu ne ggeyeena kye ki, era biri wa?

Mukama,—1. Eggulu ne ggeyeena mbeera bbiri ezikontana mu nsi ey’omwoyo. Ensibuko yaazo eri mu mutima gw’omuntu era mu nsi muno omusingi gwazo mwe guteekebwa. Okuva omuntu bw’atasobola kulaba mwoyo gwe, bw’atyo tasobola kulaba mbeera zino ebbiri ez’emmeeme. Naye azimanyira munda mu ye, ng’omuntu bw’awulira obulumi olw’okukubwa era bw’awulira obuwoomi olw’okulya ebiwoomerera. Ekiwundu ekivudde ku kukubwa kiyinza okweyongera okutuusa lwe kireeta obulumi obusingayo era ku nkomerero ne kivaamu okufa n’okuvunda, ng’ate ku luuyi olulala ebiwoomerera bwe biyinza, bwe bimala okugaaya mu lubuto, okwongera amaanyi. Mu ngeri y’emu obulumi bw’ekikolwa eky’ekibi n’essanyu ly’ekikolwa ekirungi biyinza okulabika amangu ago mu kigero ekimu, naye ekibonerezo ekijjuvu oba empeera enzijuvu olw’ebyo birimanyibwa bwokka ng’omuntu ayingidde mu nsi ey’omwoyo.

2. Mu nsi muno omuntu tamatira bbanga ddene n’ekintu kimu, wabula bulijjo anoonya enkyukakyuka mu mbeera ze oba mu bimwetoolodde; kino kiraga lwatu nti ebintu by’ensi eno ebiyita amangu tebiyinza n’akatono kumumatiza, kubanga ayagala ekintu ekinywevu era ekitakyuka era ekimusanyusa bulijjo ng’okwagala kwe n’okwegomba kwe bwe biri. Bw’amala mu kunoonya kwe okuzuula ekintu kino ekya ddala mu nze, okwegomba kw’enkyukakyuka endala zonna kukoma, kubanga omuntu tako mu kubeera wamu okutuukiridde n’essanyu ejjuvu, kubanga kino kye kintu kimu kyokka omubiri n’omwoyo bye byetaaga. Mazima, okufuna emirembe egy’amazima kye kigendererwa kimu kyokka eky’emmeeme y’omuntu. Oluusi mu mutima gw’omuntu, nga talowoozezza wadde okwegomba ye, mujjamu amangu enneewulira ey’essanyu oba ey’obulumi eva mu nsi ey’omwoyo ey’eggulu oba eya ggeyeena. Bino bimujjira emirundi n’emirundi, mpolampola ekimu ku byo ne kiwangula, ng’empisa ye ey’omwoyo bw’eri, era olw’okwetwalira obutayosa ekimu ku byo akola okusalawo okusembayo. Mu ngeri eno omusingi gw’eggulu oba ogwa ggeyeena guzimbibwa mu mutima gw’omuntu ng’akyali mu nsi muno, era oluvannyuma lw’okufa ayingira mu mbeera eyo, mu bulamu buno, okwegomba kwe oba okuyaayaana kwe gye byamutegekera.

3. Abamu bagamba nti okwegomba kye kikolo ky’obulumi bwonna n’ennaku, n’olwekyo si kituufu okwegomba essanyu mu ggulu oba mu kussa ekimu ne Katonda, kubanga obulokozi buli mu kutta okwegomba kwonna. Okwogera bwe kutyo busirusiru bunene ng’okugamba omuntu alumwa ennyonta atte ennyonta ye mu kifo ky’okumuwa amazzi okunywa, kubanga ennyonta oba okwegomba kitundu ku bulamu bwennyini. Okuggyawo okwegomba oba ennyonta nga tobimatizza kwe kuzikiriza obulamu, era kino si bulokozi wabula kufa. Ng’ennyonta bw’eraga nti waliwo amazzi, era amazzi ne gagendererwa okumalawo ennyonta, bwe kityo okubeerawo kw’okwegomba mu mmeeme kulaga nti waliwo essanyu ery’amazima n’emirembe. Emmeeme bw’ezuula oyo eyagisimbamu okwegomba okwo, efuna okumatira okusinga ennyo omuntu alumwa ennyonta kw’afuna okuva mu mazzi, era okumatizibwa kuno okw’okwegomba kw’emmeeme kwe tuyita eggulu.

4. Waliwo bangi mu nsi muno abafaanana omusajja eyafa ennyonta newaakubadde nga yali wakati mu mazzi g’ennyanja agataliiko nkomerero, kubanga amazzi g’ennyanja tegaasobola kumalawo nnyonta ye wadde okuwonya obulamu bwe. Bwe batyo waliwo abantu ababeera mu nnyanja y’okwagala etaliiko nkomerero, naye kubanga amazzi amalungi ag’ekisa kya Katonda gabakaawa mu bujeemu bwabwe ne mu kibi kyabwe, bafa ennyonta. Naye eri abo abeenenya ekibi kyabwe ne bakyukira gye ndi, ensulo z’amazzi amalamu zifubutuka okuva mu nnyanja eyo ey’okwagala, ne basanga mu oyo abaagala okumatira n’emirembe egy’olubeerera. Na kino tukiyita eggulu.

5. Waliwo bangi abaagala ensi era abagyewaddeyo ennyo ne kiba nti newaakubadde ng’olw’ekyokulabirako n’okuyigiriza kw’abaana bange emitima gyabwe emirundi mingi gisitulwa okwolekera eggulu, naye nga basikibwa wansi amaanyi agasika ag’ensi, ng’amayinja agakasukiddwa waggulu, baddamu ne bagwa mu nsi era ku nkomerero ne baserera mu ggeyeena. Naye omuntu bw’akyusa omutima gwe gye ndi mu kwenenya okw’amazima, nnongoosa yeekaalu y’omutima gwe n’embooko ez’okwagala ne ngifuula ekifo eky’omu ggulu omubeera Kabaka wa bakabaka. Obulamu buno obw’oku nsi buli bwe buti nti ekitiibwa n’ekyejalabya bya bakabaka birabibwa leero bwokka, enkya ne bitabulwa mu nfuufu. Naye abo abafuuka abaana b’obwakabaka bwa Katonda balina ekitiibwa n’ettendo, entebe z’obwakabaka n’engule, era obwakabaka bwabwe, gwe ggulu, tebuliiko nkomerero.

6. Aboonoonyi okwongera ku masanyu gaabwe babba ebintu ebirungi eby’abalala, era eyo y’ensonga lwaki abantu, abalungi n’ababi, basiba ennyumba zaabwe bwe bagenda ewala. Era okusiba ebintu kuno kulina okugenda mu maaso ebbanga lyonna emitima gy’abantu lye ginaaba nga giggaliddwa Mukama waabwe era Omutonzi waabwe. Naye ekkufulu ly’omutima bwe liggulirwawo oyo ayimiridde ng’akonkona ku luggi (Okubikkulirwa 3:20), okwegomba n’okuyaayaana kw’omutima birituukirizibwa. Olwo tekirikyetaagisa kusiba nnyumba, kubanga mu kifo ky’okubbagana ebintu n’okukolagana obubi bonna baliweerezagana mu kwagala. Kubanga abantu bwe banaawa Katonda ekimusaanira, baligabana ku kwagala kwe, era mu kuweerezagana banaanoonyanga kirungi kyokka. Bwe batyo bayingira mu ssanyu lye ery’ekitalo ne mu mirembe gye; era kino kye ggulu.

7. Bwe nnawaayo obulamu bwange ku musaalaba ku lw’abaana b’abantu ndyoke ndokole aboonoonyi okuva mu ggeyeena mbatwale mu ggulu, ababbi babiri, omu ku buli ludda lwange, baafiira mu kiseera kye kimu. Newaakubadde nga mu ndabika ffe abasatu ffenna twatuukibwako ekintu kye kimu, mu by’omwoyo waaliwo enjawulo nnene nnyo. Omu ku bo yaggalira omutima gwe gye ndi n’afa nga teyeenenyezza, naye omulala n’aggulira omutima gwe gye ndi mu kwenenya okw’amazima, era mu kussa ekimu nange n’afuna obulamu, era ku lunaku olwo lwennyini n’ayingira nange mu Lusuku lwa Katonda (Lukka 23:39-43). Olusuku lwa Katonda luno terubeerawo emitala w’entaana kyokka, wabula lutandikira mu mitima gy’abantu kaakano, newaakubadde nga lukwekeddwa amaaso g’ensi (Lukka 17:21). Omujulizi wange omwesigwa yali ali kumpi kufa oluvannyuma lw’okubonaabona ebitategeerekeka mu mikono gy’abaali bamuyigganya, era yali ajjudde nnyo essanyu ery’omu ggulu ne kiba nti n’abakyukira n’agamba nti, “Singa nnali nsobola okubaggulira omutima gwange, ne mbalaga emirembe egy’ekitalo gye nnina, ensi gy’etayinza kuwa wadde okuggyawo! Olwo mwandikakasizza nti ga mazima, naye eno ye maanu eyakwekebwa etalabika era etayinza kulabika.” Oluvannyuma lw’okufa kwe abantu abo abasirusiru ne bamuggyamu omutima, nga basuubira okusangamu ekintu eky’omuwendo, naye ne batasangamu kintu kyonna, kubanga obwa ddala bw’eggulu eryo bumanyibwa abo bokka abalikkiriza ne basanga mu lyo essanyu lyabwe.

8. Olubuto lwa Maliyamu, mwe nnabeera mu ngeri ey’omubiri okumala emyezi mitono, terwali kifo kya mukisa nga omutima gw’omukkiriza mwe mbeera emirembe gyonna ne ngufuula eggulu (Lukka 9:27, 28).

9. Waliwo bangi abeegomba eggulu naye ne baliganyibwa ddala olw’obusirusiru bwabwe. Omusabiriza omwavu yatuula okumala emyaka amakumi abiri mu gumu waggulu ku kisenge ky’obugagga ekyali kikwekeddwa, era yali ayagala nnyo okugaggawala ne kiba nti yaterekanga obusente bwonna obw’ekikomo bwe yafunanga. Naye n’afa mu bwavu obw’ennaku, nga tamanyi n’akatono obugagga bwe yali atuddeko okumala emyaka. Kubanga yatuula ebbanga ddene mu kifo kye kimu, ne wabaawo okuteebereza nti yaliko ekintu eky’omuwendo kye yali aziise awo. Bw’atyo Gavana n’alagira ekifo kisimibwe, n’azuula ebintu eby’omuwendo ebingi ebyaterekebwa, oluvannyuma ebyatwalibwa mu ggwanika lya kabaka. Ekigambo kyange kiri kumpi ddala ne w’oli, kiri mu kamwa ko ne mu mutima gwo (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 30:14).

10. Abo abatamanyi kintu kyonna ku bulamu obw’omwoyo bagamba nti tekisoboka kufuna mirembe gya ddala n’essanyu ery’omu ggulu mu nsi eno ejjudde ennaku. Naye abo abamanyi obulamu obw’omwoyo bamanyi nti ng’omuntu bw’asanga wano ne wali wakati mu bitundu by’omuzira eby’ensi ezinnyogovu ennyo emigga egy’amazzi agookya egikulukuta, bwe kityo wakati mu nsi eno ennyogovu era ejjudde ennaku musangibwa nga mukulukuta mu mitima gy’abakkiriza emigga egiwummuza egy’emirembe egy’omu ggulu, kubanga omuliro ogukwekeddwa ogw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu gwaka munda mu bo.

11. Newaakubadde nga Katonda yakola abantu bonna mu musaayi gumu era yabatonda bonna mu kifaananyi kye ne mu kufaanana kwe, yabafuula ab’enjawulo mu mpisa, mu mbeera n’obusobozi. Kubanga singa ebimuli byonna mu nsi byali bya langi emu era ab’akawoowo ke kamu, olwo ensi yennyini yandifiiriddwa obulungi bwayo. Ebimyanso by’enjuba bwe biyita mu ndabirwamu eza langi tebikyusa langi zaazo, wabula bireeta bulesi obulungi bwazo obw’enjawulo n’okusikiriza kwazo. Mu ngeri y’emu Enjuba ey’Obutuukirivu, mu nsi muno ne mu ggulu, ng’eyita mu mpisa ennungi Katonda z’awadde abakkiriza n’abatukuvu, bulijjo eyoleka ekitiibwa kyayo n’okwagala kwayo okutaliiko kkomo. Bwe ntyo mbeera mu bo nabo mu nze, era baliba n’essanyu emirembe n’emirembe.

Ekitundu II

Omuyigirizwa,—Mukama, abantu abamu bagamba nti okubudaabudibwa n’essanyu abakkiriza bye bafuna biva busa mu birowoozo byabwe n’endowooza zaabwe. Kino kituufu?

Mukama,—1. Okubudaabudibwa okwo n’emirembe egy’olubeerera abakkiriza bye balina munda mu bo biva ku kubeerawo kwange mu mitima gyabwe, ne ku kukola okuwa obulamu okw’obujjuvu bw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Ate abo abagamba nti essanyu lino ery’omwoyo liva mu birowoozo by’omutima byokka, bafaanana omusajja omusirusiru eyazaalibwa nga muzibe w’amaaso, era eyatuulanga ebweru ku musana mu kiseera eky’obutiti okwota. Bwe baamubuuza kye yalowooza ku bbugumu ly’enjuba, n’awakana n’amaanyi nti tewali kintu ng’enjuba, n’agamba nti, “Ebbugumu lino lye mpulira kaakano ku ngulu liva munda mu mubiri gwange, era si kirala okuggyako amaanyi ag’ebirowoozo byange. Bino bya bwereere ddala abantu bye bambuulira ku kintu ekiringa omupiira omunene ogw’omuliro ogwawanikibwa mu bbanga.” N’olwekyo mwekuume, waleme kubaawo abakwata “mu bufirosoofo ne mu by’obulimba ebitaliimu, okugobereranga obulombolombo obw’abantu n’ebiyigirizibwa abantu.” (Abakkolosaayi 2:8).

2. Singa essanyu ery’amazima lyesigamye ku birowoozo by’omuntu, olwo abafirosoofo bonna n’abalowooza ennyo bandibadde bajjudde nnyo essanyu eryo. Naye okuggyako abo ku bo abanzikiriza, abo abagezi mu bufirosoofo bw’ensi eno tebalina ssanyu n’akatono, okuggyako ekika ky’okwesiima okuyita amangu kwe bafuna mu kugoberera amateeka agamu ge beekoledde.

Naye omuntu namutonda mu ngeri nti alina obusobozi obw’obutonde okwaniriza Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ye yekka mw’asobola okufunira obulamu buno obw’omu ggulu n’essanyu. Ng’ekisiriiza bwe kirina obusobozi obw’obutonde okufuna omuliro, naye awatali mukka gwa okisijeni omuliro teguyinza kukiyingira, bwe kityo okuggyako ng’omukka gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu gufunye we guyingirira mu mmeeme y’omuntu, ajja kusigala mu kizikiza era tajja kunyumirwa n’akatono mirembe gino egy’amazima era egy’olubeerera (Yokaana 3:8).

3. Obusobozi buno obw’omutima n’ebirowoozo by’omuntu bufaanana n’obw’enkoba za ggita oba eza vayolini. Bwe zinywezebwa ne zikwatagana, olwo bwe zikwatibwako ekikubyo oba omusunsuzo, ennyimba ezisingayo obulungi zivaamu; naye bwe kitakolebwa bwe kityo, okukwatako kw’omusunsuzo kuleeta bulesi amaloboozi agatakwatagana. Era okuvaamu kw’amaloboozi amawoomu ng’enkoba zonna zikwatagana nakwo kwesigama ku mpewo, olw’amaanyi gaayo n’okutambula kwayo eddoboozi kwe litwalibwa mu kutu. Mu ngeri y’emu, okukwataganya ebirowoozo n’endowooza z’abantu, okubeerawo kw’omukka ogusiikuula ogw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu kwetaagisa. Bwe gubaawo, mu mitima gy’abantu mujja kuvaamu ennyimba ez’omu ggulu n’amaloboozi agakwatagana ag’essanyu, mu bulamu buno ne mu ggulu.

Omuyigirizwa,—Mukama, oluusi mpulira nti emirembe gyange n’essanyu lyange bigenze. Kino kiva ku kibi kyange ekimu ekikwekeddwa, oba waliwo ensonga endala gye simanyi?

Mukama,—1. Weewaawo, kino oluusi kiva ku bujeemu, naye oluusi ndabika ng’aleka abaana bange okumala akaseera katono, olwo ne bafuuka abali bokka era abatateredde. Awo nga bali mu mbeera eyo nsobola okubabikkulira bwe bali ddala n’obunafu bwabwe bwonna, ne mbayigiriza nti awatali nze tebali kirala okuggyako amagumba amakalu (Ezeekyeri 37:1-14); balemenga, nga bali mu mbeera ey’okuwummula n’emirembe obutayosa, okwerabira embeera yaabwe entuufu, ne beetwala nga Katonda, ne bagwa olw’amalala mu kibonerezo kya ggeyeena (1 Timoseewo 3:6; Yuda 6; Isaaya 14:12-17). Mu ngeri eno bagunjulwa era bayigirizibwa; era bwe babeera mu nze, eyabatonda, n’obwetoowaze n’obuwombeefu, balinyumirwa essanyu ery’olubeerera mu ggulu.

2. Oluusi kibaawo nti bwe nnyingira mu baana bange ne mbajjuza obujjuvu bw’Omwoyo, bajjula essanyu ery’obwakatonda n’okujaguza okungi bwe kutyo ne batasobola kugumira kitiibwa n’omukisa ebibaweereddwa, ne bagwa mu mbeera ey’okuzirika oba wadde okubula okutegeera. Kubanga omubiri n’omusaayi tebiyinza kusikira bwakabaka bwa Katonda, wadde ebintu ebiyita okusikira ebyo eby’olubeerera, okutuusa abantu lwe balisumululwa okuva mu buyinza bw’obufu obutaliimu ne bazuukizibwa mu kitiibwa (1 Abakkolinso 15:50, 53; Abaruumi 8:19-22). Olwo by’ayagala bya nze birikolebwa ku nsi mu buli kitonde, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu. Olwo obulumi n’okubonaabona, ennaku n’okusinda, okukaaba n’okufa birimalibwawo emirembe gyonna, era abaana bange bonna baliyingira mu bwakabaka bwa Kitange, bwe ssanyu mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, era balifuga emirembe n’emirembe (Abaruumi 14:17; Okubikkulirwa 21:4; 22:5).

fields.title: Essaala
fields.body_html:
Mukama omwagalwa, emikisa gyo emingi egy’engeri nnyingi n’ebirabo byo bijjuzizza omutima gwange okwebaza n’okutendereza okw’ekitalo. Naye okutendereza kw’omutima n’olulimi tekummala okutuusa lwe nnaakakasa olw’ebikolwa byange nti obulamu bwange buweereddwayo eri okukuweereza. Okwebaza n’ettendo bibe gy’oli olw’okunzigya, newaakubadde nga sisaanira, mu kufa n’onnyingiza mu bulamu, n’onsanyusa mu kussa ekimu naawe ne mu kwagala kwo. Simanyi nga bwe kisaanidde nze kennyini wadde obwetaavu bwange obunene, naye ggwe, Ayi Kitaffe, omanyi bulungi ddala ebitonde byo n’ebyetaago byabyo. So sisobola kweyagala nga ggwe bw’onjagala. Okweyagala mu mazima kwe kwagala n’omutima n’emmeeme okwagala okwo okutaliiko kkomo okwampa okubeerawo, era okwagala okwo ggwe. Kyewava ompa omutima gumu gwokka, gunywere ku omu yekka, ku ggwe, eyagutonda.

Mukama, okutuula ku bigere byo kisinga nnyo okutuula ku ntebe y’obwakabaka esingayo ekitiibwa ku nsi, kubanga kitegeeza okutuuzibwa ku ntebe emirembe gyonna mu bwakabaka obw’olubeerera. Era kaakano, ku kyoto eky’ebigere bino ebitukuvu, nneewaayo nga ssaddaaka eyokebwa. Nkkiriza olw’ekisa kyo, era wonna w’oyagala ne mu ngeri yonna gy’oyagala, onkozese mu kukuweereza. Kubanga ggwe oli wange, nange ndi wuwo, ggwe eyatwala olubatu luno olw’enfuufu n’onkola mu kifaananyi kyo ggwe kennyini era n’ompa obuyinza okufuuka omwana wo.

Ekitiibwa kyonna n’ettendo n’okutendereza n’okwebaza bibe gy’oli emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina.
